* Self\-motivated, reliable, and able to work independently

The Niles Foundation (TNF) is a community\-based nonprofit organization working to advance environmental justice, food security, clean mobility, climate resilience, economic opportunity, and community well\-being.

Through initiatives such as the Halo Food Project, EVCLEAN15, community engagement programs, leadership development efforts, and climate resilience initiatives, TNF works alongside residents, partners, and stakeholders to create meaningful opportunities and lasting community impact.***\*\*\*Only serious candidates apply.***

**Position Summary**

The Strategic Operations Coordinator supports the daily operations and organizational activities of The Niles Foundation.

This role helps maintain organizational continuity by supporting communications, community engagement activities, events, administrative functions, and operational coordination across TNF initiatives. The Strategic Operations Coordinator works closely with the Director and team members to help ensure that projects, partnerships, events, and organizational priorities continue moving forward efficiently.

This position is ideal for someone who is dependable, organized, eager to learn, able to work independently, and enjoys being part of a collaborative team environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

*Administrative \& Organizational Support*

* Coordinate meetings and scheduling.
* Maintain organized digital files and records.
* Track action items, deadlines, and follow\-up tasks.
* Maintain contact lists and organizational databases.
* Assist with data entry and general administrative support.
* Help ensure important communications and commitments stay organized and on schedule.

*Communications Support*

* Respond to routine inquiries and requests.
* Assist with communications to community members, volunteers, partners, and stakeholders.
* Prepare reminders, updates, and meeting communications.
* Support outreach and engagement efforts.

*Community \& Event Support*

* Assist with community events, workshops, meetings, and outreach activities.
* Help coordinate volunteer communications and event registrations.
* Support event logistics and participant engagement.
* Assist with surveys, sign\-ins, and community data collection activities.

*Operations Support*

* Support organizational systems and processes.
* Assist with project tracking and coordination.
* Help maintain organizational continuity and follow\-through.
* Support special projects and emerging organizational needs as assigned.

**Qualifications**

*Minimum Qualifications*

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Basic computer proficiency, including Microsoft Office, Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, or similar tools.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and follow through on assignments.
* Ability to work efficiently and independently.

*Preferred Qualifications*

* Experience in customer service, administration, nonprofit work, community engagement, events, education, public service, or related fields.
* Experience coordinating meetings, volunteers, events, community activities, or projects.
* Experience working with diverse communities.
* Bilingual skills are a plus but not required.

**Entry\-level and experienced candidates are strongly encouraged to apply.**

**Who We're Looking For**

We're less concerned about finding the "perfect" candidate and more interested in finding the right person.

The ideal candidate is:

* Reliable and dependable
* Honest and trustworthy
* Self\-motivated and proactive
* Organized and detail\-oriented
* Able to work efficiently and independently
* Comfortable taking initiative and solving problems
* Professional and respectful in communications
* Works well in collaborative team environments
* Willing to learn new skills and take on new responsibilities
* Able to adapt to changing priorities
* Passionate about community\-centered work

**We value integrity, accountability, communication, teamwork, and a willingness to learn just as much as prior experience.**

*If you don't meet every qualification listed but believe you would be a strong fit for this role, we encourage you to apply.*

**Local Candidates Strongly Encouraged to Apply**

The Niles Foundation is committed to creating meaningful employment opportunities within the communities we serve.

We strongly encourage applications from local residents and individuals with ties to Los Angeles County and surrounding communities. As a community\-based organization, we believe investing in local talent strengthens our programs, partnerships, and long\-term impact.

jobs.title: Community Outreach Worker
jobs.description:
**About AADAP, Inc.** The Asian American Drug Abuse Program (AADAP) is a 501(c)(3\) non\-profit organization dedicated to serving Asian Pacific Islanders and other underserved communities with substance abuse services throughout Los Angeles County. Programs and services are provided to all individuals regardless of race or ethnicity.

**Department Overview** The Community Integrated Prevention (CIP) unit within the Prevention Department drives health equity, environmental advocacy, and community education around alcohol, tobacco, and other drugs (ATOD) across the South Bay (SPA 8\) region. Through youth and adult coalition building, policy advocacy, and community outreach, CIP empowers residents to create safer, healthier environments.

**Position Summary** The CIP Outreach Worker supports alcohol and other drug (AOD) education and prevention outreach across the South Bay (SPA 8\) region. Reporting directly to the Prevention CIP Coordinator and guided by Community Organizers (CO I and CO II), this position assists with community presentations, trainings, digital content creation, event tabling, and volunteer engagement to drive social and policy change.

**Essential Job Functions \& Responsibilities**

**Target Area Organizing**

* Assist Community Organizers with preparing and delivering alcohol, tobacco, and other drug (AOD) education presentations, workshops, and trainings across SPA 8\.
* Assist in mobilizing community members for policy campaigns aimed at reducing youth access to alcohol, tobacco, and other drugs.
* Support the educational development of youth and adult coalition members in collaboration with local and regional prevention partners.
* Assist with conducting comprehensive community assessments across assigned target areas in the South Bay (SPA 8\) region.
* Develop creative educational outreach materials using media advocacy, including social media posts/reels, flyers, virtual training videos, and podcasts.
* Educate, inform, and cultivate awareness around ATOD issues with city, county, and state decision\-makers and city staff.
* Support the implementation of Strategic Prevention Framework (SPF) action plans by engaging local youth and adult volunteers.
* Transport supplies, media materials, and outreach equipment to field sites using a personal vehicle.
* Provide recommendations for contract plans based on emerging community needs, trends, and issues.

**County\-Wide Organizing**

* Participate in county\-based roundtables, regional task forces, and coalition\-based meetings.
* Assist with community advocacy surrounding local, state, and federal policy decisions impacting prevention.

**Administrative Support**

* Comply with city, county, state, and federal contractual agreements.
* Maintain accurate field documentation, outreach logs, and evaluation files.
* Prepare and submit billing reports and required administrative tracking documentation on time.

**Department \& Agency**

* Attend required department, unit, and agency\-sponsored meetings and events.
* Represent AADAP professionally at local, state, and federal forums, conferences, and community gatherings.
* Perform other related duties as assigned.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* **Education:** High School Diploma or equivalent (GED) required.
* **Transportation:** Valid California Driver’s License, active personal vehicle insurance, and reliable transportation.
* **Special Qualification:** Must have three (3\) years of continuous recovery or a drug\-free lifestyle as of the date of application.

**Nice to Have**

* Bilingual or bicultural capabilities in Los Angeles County threshold languages (e.g., Spanish, Tagalog, Korean, Samoan, Tongan, Hawaiian, or other AAPI languages); Spanish fluency strongly preferred.
* Knowledge of substance use disorders, AOD prevention, and community issues in the South Bay (SPA 8\) region.
* Experience creating digital media content (social media graphics, reels, flyers, or basic video editing).

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities (KSAs)**

* Ability to get along well with others, be punctual, pleasant, and tactful with professional appearance and conduct.
* Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with supervisors, coworkers, clients and their families, community organizations, and the general public.
* Demonstrates cultural awareness and empathy across age groups, gender identity, sexual orientation, spiritual beliefs, socioeconomic status, and diverse cultures.
* Demonstrated knowledge and skill in computer operations and basic data entry for outreach tracking.
* Ability to understand community concerns deeply, listen actively, and build authentic rapport with diverse groups.
* Ability to pivot calmly in field environments, troubleshoot unexpected events, and work collaboratively with supervisors, peers, and external partners.
* Basic experience with media content creation, including social media graphics, reels, flyers, or video editing. (Preferred)
* Ability to comfortably present information, co\-facilitate workshops, and engage youth and adult community members during public events and tabling outreach. (Preferred)
* Ability to manage field logistics, transport and set up outreach supplies, and work independently with minimal direct supervision. (Preferred)

**Special Requirements**

* Employment contingent upon successful background check clearance.
* Permanent resident or U.S. Citizen; proof of work eligibility required upon hire.
* TB test within seven (7\) days of hiring.

**Work Schedule, Travel \& Physical Demands**

* **Schedule:** Part\-time, regular (20 hours per week); requires flexibility for occasional evening and weekend community events.
* **Travel:** Local field travel required throughout the South Bay (SPA 8\) region using a personal vehicle.
* **Physical Requirements:** Moderate Duty. Requires standing or walking most of the time, with frequent bending, stooping, squatting, twisting, reaching, and working on irregular surfaces.

jobs.description:

Vast is rapidly developing its multi\-module Haven Station to ensure a continuous human presence in space for America and its allies, enabling advanced microgravity research and manufacturing, and unlocking a new space economy for government, corporate, and private customers. Haven Demo's 2025 success made Vast the only operational commercial space station company to fly and operate its own spacecraft. Next, Haven\-1 is expected to become the world's first commercial space station when it launches in 2027, followed by additional Haven modules. Additionally, the company recently announced **Vast Satellite**, a high\-power satellite product line leveraging its space station components and the heritage of Haven Demo.



Headquartered in **Long Beach, California**, and with more than 1,000 employees and over a billion dollars in private capital, Vast has built the facilities required to manufacture and operate America's next space station. The company plans to develop future habitats and systems for the Moon and Mars, dedicated space stations for government partners, and other crewed systems that will unlock the expanding long\-term space economy.



At Vast, our mission is to contribute to a future where billions of people are living and thriving in space. Vast is developing next\-generation space stations to ensure a continuous human presence in space for America and its allies, enabling advanced microgravity research and manufacturing, and unlocking a new space economy for government, corporate, and private customers. Using an incremental, hardware\-rich and low\-cost approach, Vast is rapidly developing its multi\-module Haven Station. Haven Demo's 2025 success made Vast the only operational commercial space station company to fly and operate its own spacecraft. Next, Haven\-1 is expected to become the world's first commercial space station when it launches, followed by additional Haven modules to enable permanent human presence by 2030\. Our team is all\-in, committed to executing our mission safely and on time. If you want to work with the most talented people on Earth furthering space exploration for humanity, come join us.



Vast is looking for a **Procurement Coordinator, Indirect,** reporting to the **Director of Supply Chain**, to support the development of the systems required to design and build artificial\-gravity, human\-rated space stations.



This will be a **full\-time**, **non\-****exempt** position located in our **Long Beach** location.


**Responsibilities:**


* Purchase order placement and open order management.
* Support Vast Supplier management including tasks such as onboarding, performance monitoring, compliance verification, and relationship management, requiring dedicated oversight.
* Assist with consistent communication, contract follow\-ups, and resolution of supply chain issues.
* Ensures procurement activities adhere to policies, reducing organizational and supply chain risk.
* + Activities include Supplier due diligence and documentation tracking now demand sustained focus to maintain audit\-readiness and regulatory compliance.
* Tackle high volume data entry and data migration.
* Manage and drive supplier issue ticket resolution, RMA processing and billing/AP discrepancies
* Enable Procurement team to focus on high\-value tasks such as negotiations and procurement strategies, while managing day\-to\-day operational procurement.

jobs.title: Loro Piana, Seasonal Operations Specialist, Beverly Hills
jobs.description:
### **Position**

Loro Piana is an Italian luxury Maison founded in 1924, known for creating the finest quality textiles, ready\-to\-wear collections, accessories, and bespoke garments. Our dedication to exceptional craftsmanship and use of the world’s finest raw materials positions us a leader in the luxury industry. As an iconic Maison within the LVMH group, we uphold a strong commitment to unparalleled quality and excellence.  



General Purpose of the Position:


We are seeking a Seasonal Operations Specialist to join our team at Loro Piana. The Operations Specialist plays a pivotal role in the overall success of the business by supporting all operational and inventory\-related activities. You will be responsible for managing incoming and outgoing shipments, replenishing products on the sales floor, and organizing inventory to maximize efficiency. You will collaborate with all members of the team to ensure that stockroom conditions align with Loro Piana standards, contributing to seamless store operations.


### **Job responsibilities**

Key Responsibilities


* Optimize inventory flow and streamline operational processes while handling the accurate processing of shipments and transfers.
* Oversee the movement of merchandise from the stockroom to the sales floor and maintain appropriate inventory levels to align with sales potential.
* Conduct cycle counts as per corporate calendar to verify product quantities and report discrepancies in a timely manner. Perform regular audits to verify product conditions.
* Facilitate the implementation of security measures through inspections, audits, and preparing products for display.
* Ensure ongoing inventory organization according to company procedures and establish an optimized warehouse layout for improved accessibility by the sales team.
* Maintain clean, neat, and organized stock rooms with proper labeling to facilitate sales.
* Maintain effective communication with the operations team and external couriers to ensure accurate shipping procedures and timely delivery.
Provide the sales team with detailed updates regarding inventory availability to support the sales process and enhance sales performance.  
* 
### **Profile**

Skills and Abilities Required


* 3\+ years of operational and inventory experience, preferably in a luxury retail environment.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office, SAP, and other digital tools.
* Excellent communication, teamwork, and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong knowledge of operations and inventory control.
* Ability to lift and move objects up to 40 pounds.
### **Additional information**

What we offer


At Loro Piana, we believe in fostering a supportive and rewarding work environment that values our employees' well\-being and growth. We offer a comprehensive range of benefits including medical, dental, and vision coverage, fertility support, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, tuition reimbursement, 401K match, and Headspace mental health support. Additionally, employees enjoy a generous product discount, exclusive LVMH discounts, and other tailored perks.


Compensation


Loro Piana uses the published salary range as a guideline to provide our employees with market\-competitive pay while allowing for flexibility to recognize and reward various levels of expertise, performance, and tenure.
  

  

While the published salary range is a good faith reflection of the targeted salary level for the position, Loro Piana reserves the right to pay outside of the published salary range of $24 to $26 USD per hour.
  

  

EEO Statement


We strive to create a culture of inclusion where everyone has a sense of belonging. Our goal is to ensure that our outreach and recruiting efforts generate diverse identities and perspectives that will be valued and can thrive. We are continuously assessing our employee and candidate populations to identify ways to ensure they are all\-encompassing and equitable.


***LORO PIANA***
**MAISON**
---------------------------

Originally from Trivero in northern Italy, the Loro Piana family began trading wool in the early 1800s. In 1924, Pietro Loro Piana founded Ing. Loro Piana \& C., the current company. Pietro’s nephew Franco took over in 1941, and after the war the firm began to establish its reputation as a supplier of premium wool and cashmere textiles for a growing haute couture industry, both home and abroad. In the 1970s, Sergio and Pier Luigi Loro Piana took up the reins, diversifying into luxury goods and developing an international retail arm. Now the world’s foremost cashmere processor, Loro Piana prides itself on sourcing the very finest, rarest raw materials the world has to offer, including unique cashmere from baby goats in northern China and Mongolia, vicuña from the Andes, extra\-fine Merino wool from Australia and New Zealand and lotus flower fiber from Myanmar. The company draws on both time\-honored traditions and state of the art technology to offer its discerning customers products that are renowned for their peerless quality. All of the company’s collections of ready\-to\-wear garments and accessories are made in Italy to the highest standards of craftsmanship and sartorial excellence.

jobs.title: Social Media & Digital Communications Specialist
jobs.description:
**ABOUT ROCKET LAB**



Rocket Lab is the end\-to\-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity's reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

**SOCIAL MEDIA \& DIGITAL COMMUNICATIONS SPECIALIST**

The Rocket Lab communications team translates literal rocket science into impactful and compelling stories that captivate the globe. We are looking for a Social Media \& Digital Communications Specialist who lives and breathes digital storytelling, thrives in high\-stakes environments, and wants to run one of the most exciting feeds in space. This is not a cruise\-control 9\-to\-5\. Rockets launch at 3:00 AM, mission milestones happen in real\-time across multiple time zones, and the unexpected is around every corner. If you want a comfortable corporate routine, this isn't it. If you want to shape the voice of a company shaping humanity's future in space, read on.


**WHAT YOU'LL GET TO DO:**

* **Build the Content Engine:** Plan, maintain, and execute an aggressive digital editorial calendar aligned with missions, program milestones, and strategic company goals.
* **Own the Channels**: Lead day\-to\-day execution across X, LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, Bluesky, subscriber newsletters and emerging platforms.
* **Understand the Audience:** Tailor content to our broad range of audiences spanning B2B and B2G, talent candidates, investors, and fans.
* **Cover the Action in Real Time:** Work with our media content producers to capture, package, and publish live coverage for launches, hot fires, spacecraft deployments, trade shows, and major company milestones.
* **Translate Rocket Science**: Partner directly with engineers, mission operators, and production teams to turn complex technical achievements into sharp, accessible content.
* **Drive Growth with Data:** Monitor platform analytics, spot trends before they fade, experiment with AI tools and new formats, and ruthlessly optimize for reach and engagement.
* **Guard the Brand Voice:** Ensure every caption, clip, graphic, and post matches Rocket Lab's standard of quality, technical accuracy, and unmistakable tone.
* **Expand the Frontier:** Challenge the status quo of how aerospace communicates. Bring fresh tech, unconventional distribution strategies, and bold creative experiments that keep us leagues ahead of the industry.
* **Roll Your Sleeves Up:** This isn't a pure strategy role insulated from the execution. You are on the tools every single day, drafting, shooting, editing, and driving projects from concept to feed. You can expect to live tweet countdowns, get out onto the factory floor to get the story, write the post, and hit publish yourself.


**YOU'LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS:**

* 5\+ years of experience. Proven track record running high\-growth, high\-engagement social channels and digital campaigns for a fast\-moving brand.
* A sharp portfolio with direct proof of killer campaigns you built and executed personally.
* Experience in both organic and paid social campaigns and strategies. Deep understanding of how to roll out effective paid social and digital campaigns to serve specific business needs.
* Flexibility to travel and move fast: Ready to support on\-site activations, events, and dynamic launch schedules across time zones.


 **THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE:**

* Bachelors degree.
* Ability to distil complex ideas into short, witty, punchy copy with zero fluff and flawless attention to detail.
* Extreme ownership. You don't wait for a brief. You spot what needs doing, hunt for an answer, pick up a camera, or open a draft, and get it done.
* Calm, decisive judgment when breaking news hits or launch countdowns are ticking live.
* Experience in aerospace, defence, motorsport or tech industries.
* An authentic obsession with space exploration and technology.
* You don't have to be able to have hands on photo/video capture and mobile editing skills but it would be beneficial.
* Experience in a start\-up environment


*This position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, computer work, and occasional exposure to moderate levels of noise, dust, and fumes in production areas.*

**WHAT TO EXPECT**



We're on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that's not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out\-think, out\-work, and out\-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other's backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way.



Important information:


**FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN US OFFICES ONLY:**


*To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), Rocket Lab Employees must be a U.S. citizen, lawful U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State and/or the U.S. Department of Commerce, as applicable. Learn more about ITAR* *here**.*


*Rocket Lab provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. The Social Media Coordinator will report directly to the Sr Content \& Social Manager

Our Social Media Coordinator will work remotely from home or personal office and will be required to utilize Dhar Mann Studios time tracking software to log and submit work hours

Southern California has one of the largest and most active veterinary markets in the country. We are looking for motivated professionals who understand their local market and are ready to develop a protected territory with significant growth potential.

You will introduce veterinary hospitals, specialty and emergency practices, general practices, and other animal\-health organizations to I2F®, a patented medical device designed to support more efficient medication preparation, improve vial access, and reduce avoidable medication waste.

It is especially well suited for an established veterinary, medical, pharmaceutical, or healthcare sales professional who wants to add an innovative product to their portfolio.

This position begins with a focus on veterinary medicine. As AII expands into the human healthcare market following the necessary regulatory clearance, established representatives will have the opportunity to grow with the company and represent I2F within eligible human healthcare accounts.

**Responsibilities**

* Develop long\-term relationships with prospective and existing customers

* Represent Alexander International Innovations professionally at local conferences, meetings, and networking events when appropriate

* Comfortable entering veterinary facilities, initiating conversations, and conducting product demonstrations

* Consistent follow\-through and willingness to remain engaged throughout the sales process
* Comfortable using email, video meetings, and a web\-based CRM
* Located in the Los Angeles/Southern California area and able to travel locally within the assigned territory

**Compensation**

* No income ceiling

**What We Provide**

Trade Shows \& Event Execution

Lead Generation \& Pipeline Building

The Project Coordinator provides administrative and organizational support to Project Managers in the planning and delivery of renewable energy installation projects, including commercial solar, battery storage systems (BESS), and electric vehicle charging infrastructure. This role supports day\-to\-day project operations, manages project documentation, prepares project materials, and develops foundational project management skills in preparation for advancement to a Project Manager role.  

**Responsibilities:*** Provide day\-to\-day administrative and organizational support to Project Managers across active renewable energy installation projects.
* Manage and maintain project documentation including contracts, permits, submittals, RFIs, change orders, and closeout packages, ensuring all records are accurate, current, and properly filed.
* Prepare, format, and distribute project reports, meeting minutes, status updates, and client\-facing communications under the direction of the Project Manager.
* Track project schedules, milestones, and action items; follow up with internal teams to ensure deadlines are met and escalate issues to the Project Manager as appropriate.
* Support project budget tracking by assisting with purchase order coordination, invoice processing, and expenditure monitoring in collaboration with Project Managers, accounting, and supply chain teams.
* Coordinate logistics for project activities including scheduling meetings, arranging site visits, and communicating with subcontractors and vendors as directed.
* Maintain organized digital filing systems and ensure document control standards are followed across all assigned projects.
* Learn and apply project management methodologies and tools under the mentorship of Project Managers, actively developing toward full project ownership over time.

 **Experience:*** 2\-5 years of administrative, coordination, or project support experience preferred; recent graduates with relevant internships or coursework will be considered.
* Prior experience in Commercial Rooftop Solar, Canopy/Carport Solar, Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), or EV Charging Infrastructure is extremely beneficial but not required. Consideration will also be given to experience in similar industries such as telecommunications, transportation, or other specialized development and construction.

  

Pay: $30 \- $40/hr

jobs.description:
Licensing Project Coordinator \& Copywriter

**Whimsocal Studios**  
**Location:** Irvine, CA – On\-Site  
**Job Type:** Full\-Time, Non\-Exempt  
**Pay:** $25\.00 per hour  
**Reports To:** VP of Product Development

About Whimsocal Studios

Since 2009, Whimsocal Studios (formerly Orange Circle Studio) has been creating thoughtfully designed products that bring joy to everyday moments.

Our growing portfolio includes purpose\-driven brands across stationery, gifting, lifestyle, and baby categories, including **Orange Circle Studio, Studio Oh!, Saturday Sundae, JuJuBe, Bella Tunno, and Scoops.**

Our purpose is simple: **To Curate Small Joys.**

We're a collaborative team of creative thinkers, problem\-solvers, and passionate brand builders who believe creativity and thoughtful design can brighten everyday life. We work together to create products that inspire joy, foster connection, and make a meaningful impact.

About the Role

We are looking for a **Licensing Project Coordinator \& Copywriter** to join our Product Development team.

This role is ideal for someone who is **highly organized, detail\-oriented, a strong writer, and comfortable managing multiple projects and deadlines.** You'll play an important role in coordinating with licensors, internal teams, artists, customers, and other external partners while also creating and proofreading copy across a variety of products and marketing materials.

The ideal candidate enjoys both the **creative and organizational sides of product development** and can confidently manage details from initial submissions through final approvals and production.

Key ResponsibilitiesCopywriting \& Editorial

* Write clear, engaging copy for products, websites, collections, campaigns, and other marketing materials.
* Work closely with the Marketing team to maintain brand voice, tone, and consistency.
* Partner with the Digital team to create copy that supports searchability and discoverability.
* Proofread and fact\-check planners, calendars, gift products, websites, sell sheets, catalogs, presentations, and other sales and marketing materials.
* Follow established editorial style guides, procedures, and company standards.

Licensing \& Project Coordination

* Manage licensor submissions for production and marketing materials while following individual licensor marketing and style guidelines.
* Communicate with licensors and internal teams regarding submissions, revisions, approvals, and changes.
* Build and maintain strong, professional relationships with licensing partners.
* Keep internal teams informed as approvals and requested changes are received.
* Proof factory PDFs, digital proofs, pre\-production samples, advances, and reprints for accuracy.
* Maintain editorial schedules, spreadsheets, and project tracking documents.
* Coordinate artist samples for gift and dated products.
* Request sample orders from Customer Service representatives and maintain the illustrator sample spreadsheet to ensure items are fulfilled.
* Help coordinate company\-wide Employee of the Month activities.

Additional Responsibilities

* Assist with preparing presentation materials for meetings.
* Document and follow up on important action items and decisions from meetings.
* Support Marketing requests, including reviewing images and creative assets and providing product samples.
* Research consumer and product trends within the gift, stationery, calendar, and planner industries.
* Stay current on relevant trends, pop culture, and market developments and contribute ideas during brainstorming and product development meetings.
* Assist with other projects and responsibilities as needed.

Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree preferred.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong copywriting, proofreading, and editing skills.
* Extremely detail\-oriented and highly organized.
* Ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, and deadlines.
* Strong follow\-through and problem\-solving skills.
* Comfortable working independently while collaborating with a team.
* Positive, flexible attitude and ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, high\-volume creative environment.
* Strong Microsoft Office skills, including PowerPoint.
* Previous experience working with licensors is a plus.
* Experience in product development, publishing, stationery, gifting, consumer products, or a creative environment is a plus.

What We Offer

* **$25\.00 per hour**
* Medical, Dental \& Vision Insurance
* Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
* 401(k)
* Paid Vacation, Sick Time \& Holidays
* Employer\-paid Long\-Term Disability
* Employee Product Discounts
* Career Growth Opportunities

Why Join Whimsocal?

At Whimsocal Studios, you'll have the opportunity to work with a creative and collaborative team and play a hands\-on role in bringing products and ideas to life.

If you're passionate about **writing, organization, product development, and creative problem\-solving**, and you're looking for an opportunity where your attention to detail truly matters, we'd love to hear from you!

How to Apply

Please apply through this Indeed posting or submit your resume directly to **HR@whimsocal.com**. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

**Whimsocal Studios is an Equal Opportunity Employer.** All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

Whimsocal Studios provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities during the application process and in the performance of essential job functions. To request an accommodation, please contact **HR@whimsocal.com**.

At MFour, we’re transforming how businesses understand consumers in an increasingly complex, AI\-driven world. Founded in 2011, we are a leading consumer intelligence platform delivering validated, connected, and opt\-in data that powers smarter, faster decision\-making.

  

What sets us apart is our ability to connect what consumers say with what they actually do. Through our proprietary platform, MFour Studio™ and our flagship app Surveys On The Go®, we combine survey data with real\-world behaviors, creating a complete, accurate view of the consumer journey.

  

We’re also shaping the future of research through innovations like **DANI™**, our AI\-powered assistant that enables teams to quickly analyze data, uncover insights, and take action with confidence.  

  

Built on our Fair Trade Data® model, everything we do is grounded in transparency, privacy, and trust. Today, we partner with leading global brands like Google, Microsoft, and Disney to eliminate blind spots and drive better business decisions.

As our Senior Project Manager / Customer Success Manager, you'll own the end\-to\-end client experience for a portfolio of 20–30 MFour Data Research accounts — you're the person your clients count on from project kickoff through delivery and renewal. jobs.description:
Logistics Coordinator (AIR \& Ocean Operations)**Job Description**
===================

**1\. Position Overview**


The Mobile Business Unit supports the global distribution of mobile devices with a focus on speed, reliability, and operational efficiency. The Logistics Coordinator (Air \& Ocean Operations) is responsible for planning, executing, and continuously improving inbound and outbound air and ocean freight operations, ensuring shipments move efficiently from manufacturers to Samsung warehouses and ultimately to customers.


This position requires hands\-on experience in Air or Ocean Freight Operations, along with solid ocean freight knowledge. As our operation supports global transportation across multiple time zones, this position follows a five\-day work schedule that includes weekend shifts based on operational requirements.

**2\. Key Responsibilities**


1\) Planning \& Scheduling

* Create and maintain daily tracking reports for Air Export, Ocean Import and OTR including weekend operations


2\) Port \& Terminal Coordination

* Gather departure information for containers and air cargo at ports, terminals, and airports.
* Monitor and confirm on\-time departures from U.S. Ocean terminals and major airports.
* Coordinate terminal departure schedules with terminal operators and customs brokers.


3\) Movement Monitoring

* Track ocean containers, rail intermodal units, and air shipments in real time.
* Validate Import of Documentation (IOD) and Proof of Delivery (POD) on a daily basis.
* Respond promptly to shipment exceptions requiring immediate attention (e.g., delays, damages, customs hold).


4\) Transload Warehouse Management

* Oversee Transload Warehouse (TW) capacity planning and utilization.
* Manage Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for transload operations (e.g., dwell time, on\-time transload, damage rate).
* Identify and resolve operational bottlenecks and work with warehouse teams to implement corrective actions.


5\) TL OB OTR Dispatch Management

* Schedule and dispatch Truckload (TL) Outbound (OB) orders using the Transportation Management System (TMS).
* Optimize routing and load consolidation to meet service\-level agreements while minimizing transportation costs.


6\) Partner \& Stakeholder Communication

* Serve as the primary point of contact for logistics partners, including carriers, freight forwarders, customs brokers, internal supply chain teams, and customers.
* Handle claims, documentation, and issue escalations through phone, email, or virtual meetings.


7\) Compliance \& Documentation

* Ensure all shipments comply with international trade regulations, hazardous material requirements, and security standards.
* Maintain accurate records for audits and regulatory inspections.
* Perform other job\-related duties as assigned.


8\) Core Competencies

* Analytical Thinking: Translate large data sets into actionable insights.
* Problem Solving: Quickly identify root causes of operational issues and implement effective solutions.
* Communication: Communicate clearly and effectively with internal teams and external partners.
* Multitasking: Manage multiple priorities while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.
* Ability to Work Under Pressure: Perform effectively in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment.

**3\. Requirements (Basic Qualifications)**


1\) Education

* Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field.


2\) Experience

* Minimum 6 years of experience in logistics coordination, with a strong focus on international air and ocean freight operations.
* Hands\-on experience in international Air, Ocean, and OTR freight forwarding operations is required
* Proven experience managing transload warehouse operations and Truckload (TL) dispatch.


3\) Industry Knowledge

* Strong understanding of international air and ocean freight regulations, and customs procedures


4\) Technical Skills

* Proficiency with ERP and logistics systems (SAP, TMS, WMS or equivalent).
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP.

6\) Weekend work may be required.

jobs.description:
**Position Summary:**


Provides accurate, responsive, and compliance\-focused support across HR operations and the employee lifecycle. The HR Operations Coordinator processes workforce transactions, responds to employee and leader inquiries, maintains HR records, supports reporting and audits, and coordinates cross\-functional activities involving Human Resources, HR Technology, Payroll, Benefits, Information Technology, Information Security, Legal, and Records Management. The role also supports regulatory remediation activities, including Matters Requiring Attention (MRAs), by helping maintain data inventories, execute approved employee\-data retention and deletion procedures, validate results, and preserve audit evidence.

**Responsibilities:**

* Processes and monitors employee lifecycle transactions, job and organizational changes, contingent worker updates, leaves, terminations, rescissions, and related employee data corrections in Workday and connected service channels.
* Reviews requests for completeness, required approvals, effective dates, supporting documentation, and alignment with established policies, procedures, and service expectations before processing or escalation.
* Responds to routine employee and leader questions through HRConnect, shared inboxes, and other approved support channels; document activity, route complex matters to the appropriate HR partner and follow through to resolution.
* Maintains accurate and confidential personnel records, transaction documentation, acknowledgments, and operational evidence in accordance with company retention, privacy, legal\-hold, and records\-management requirements.
* Supports standard and ad hoc HR reporting, transaction audits, data\-quality reviews, exception tracking, and reconciliations; identify discrepancies and coordinate timely corrections with HR Technology or the responsible business owner.
* Assists with recurring HR programs and operational activities, including performance and compensation cycles, workforce changes, policy acknowledgments, labor\-law posting administration, work authorization tracking, and special projects.
* Partners with HR Technology and IT to troubleshoot system or workflow issues, document defects, test approved changes, and confirm that employee lifecycle processes operate as intended across Workday and downstream systems.
* Prepares process documentation, job aids, control evidence, status updates, and supporting materials for internal audits, external audits, compliance reviews, and management reporting.
* Recommends practical improvements that strengthen accuracy, timeliness, controls, employee experience, and scalability across HR operational processes.
* Supports MRA\-related workstreams involving employee data classification, retention, disposition, deletion, de\-identification, and access controls under the direction of the designated business, application, data, or risk owner.
* Maintains current inventories of HR applications, employee\-data locations, system owners, downstream interfaces, retention requirements, legal hold exceptions, and approved deletion or de\-identification rules.
* Coordinates approved deletion exercises by compiling employee populations, validating exclusions, distributing identifiers only through approved secure methods, tracking completion by system owners, and escalating delays or exceptions.
* Validates that approved HR system purge activities complete successfully and coordinate downstream confirmation, reconciliation, and issue resolution without independently changing legal, retention, security, or data\-classification requirements.
* Collects and organizes evidence of execution, including approvals, population files, validation results, exception logs, system\-owner confirmations, and remediation artifacts, in the designated controlled repository.

  



**Requirements**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Information Systems, or a related field preferred; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
* One (1\) \+ years of HR operations, HR coordination, HRIS support, records administration, compliance support, or related experience preferred.
* Experience supporting audits, data\-governance activities, regulatory remediation, or controlled operational processes is preferred.
* Working knowledge of HR operations and employee lifecycle processes; familiarity with Workday or a comparable enterprise HRIS is preferred.
* This is a hybrid position based in Irvine, CA or Chandler, AZ \- requiring two days per week.

jobs.description:
Technical Account Manager

BAY AREA · NORTHERN CALIFORNIA FULL\-TIME BASE \+ MILESTONE BONUSES \+ UNCAPPED COMMISSION

01\. ABOUT US

Trilion Quality Systems is a precision metrology and NDE company based in King of Prussia, PA, and the US representative for ZEISS IQS optical testing systems. Our sister company, Xi Analytics, develops real\-time optical metrology and AI\-based measurement technology for advanced material testing and aerospace structural applications.

As the exclusive ZEISS Certified Metrology Partner in North America, Trilion’s experienced team of thirty people has spent the last 30 years doing one thing: connecting physical measurement with certified digital insight. More than 90% of the top ten US aerospace, automotive, biomechanics, and electronics companies work with us as their ZEISS DIC partner. This means that you will spend most weeks on innovative projects at Fortune 100 aerospace, defense, automotive, and consumer electronics companies, on test articles that are usually confidential, and you will be the person they call first. We’re an agile team and you won’t waste months waiting on committees and layers of management.

02\. ABOUT THE ROLE

Trilion is opening a Bay Area office around San Mateo in 2026 and hiring a Technical Account Manager to carry Northern California. This is a quota\-carrying, field\-based role, and you will be the primary technical and commercial contact for customers in the territory from the first conversation through demonstration, proposal, purchase order, and long\-term account growth.

You will spend most of your week in front of engineers in their test labs, not behind a desk. Optical metrology is sold by showing it, so much of the job is setting up a system on a customer's test article and letting the data make the argument. Strain gauges read a handful of points and miss the concentrations and asymmetries that decide whether a design passes certification. Full\-field DIC makes every pixel a measurement point, in 3D, NIST\-traceable, and ready for FEA correlation in minutes.

You will not be just a coordinator who forwards technical questions. Once ramped, you are expected to be able to run standard demonstrations and beginner trainings yourself, with our expert engineering team behind you for complex projects, dedicated multi\-day training, and on\-site service work. The technical credibility that comes with it is how you sell on results and direct knowledge rather than on a brochure.

You will not be working a blank list. Leads reach you through ZEISS and through Trilion’s own marketing, and you will generate the rest yourself at proven trade shows, through customer referrals, and by developing accounts we already serve. Revenue splits close to evenly three ways: new accounts, new teams inside existing accounts, and recurring business from our customer base. This means that a majority of projects will come from customers who already know and trust us, which is why account management matters here as much as new business. The ramp is deliberate: expect full autonomy over the territory within 6 to 8 months, backed by milestone bonuses while the funnel builds. Your first three months will follow a structured onboarding plan with active coaching, defined milestones and hands\-on time alongside our engineers, so you are not left to work it out on your own. Capital equipment cycles are long, but we don’t starve a good engineer waiting for the first sale to close.

03\. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Territory and accounts

* Own the Bay Area and Northern California territory across aerospace, microelectronics and consumer electronics, space and defense, automotive and EV, medical device, and industrial and civil structures
* Work inbound leads from ZEISS and our digital marketing through qualification to first meeting
* Generate the rest of your pipeline yourself: trade show and conference follow\-up, referrals, and prospecting into new groups inside accounts we already serve
* Support existing accounts and identify follow\-on system, software, and service opportunities
* Forecast territory opportunities accurately and keep management updated on a regular cadence

Technical selling and delivery

* Present and demonstrate ARAMIS, ATOS, TRITOP, and the wider ZEISS portfolio at customer test labs and trade shows
* Run standard demonstrations and basic software training independently once ramped, including specimen preparation and system setup
* Process and present measurement results, and run proof\-of\-concept engagements and ROI analyses tied to the customer's test program
* Bring in our engineering team for complex projects, multi\-day training, and service work

Deal execution

* Design and develop tailored proposals and system configurations
* Manage the full sales process from first contact through purchase order
* Maintain accurate account, contact, and opportunity records in HubSpot CRM and Odoo ERP

04\. ABOUT YOU

* 2 to 3 years of experience in technical sales, applications engineering, or hands\-on test and measurement work, in aerospace \& defense, electronics \& AR/VR hardware, automotive \& EV, robotics, biomechanics, material science or an adjacent field
* MS/BS in Mechanical/Aerospace Engineering, Material Science or similar Engineering Major
* Comfortable with mechanical engineering fundamentals: strain, stress, fatigue, and structural test
* Comfortable explaining technical concepts clearly and concisely to test engineers and executives
* Hands\-on experience with test equipment or measurement instrumentation, and the confidence to run a live system demonstration in front of a customer without support
* Willing and able to generate your own pipeline: outbound calls and emails, trade show and conference follow\-up, and prospecting into adjacent groups at existing accounts
* Organized and self\-directed; this territory runs on a plan you build yourself
* Excellent computer skills including AI usage for day\-to\-day sales engineerin

jobs.title: Assistant Community Manager
jobs.description:
**Overview**



Avanath is proud to be named one of the top property management companies that provide affordable housing for the workforce.


*Cultivating the American Dream* is the purpose that binds the Avanath team. At Avanath, every day is an opportunity to make a difference in someone's life. Whether it is helping residents call one of our communities home, providing excellence in customer service, or championing our workforce, we are committed to creating an unforgettable experience as a great place to live, work, and be.


**The Role:**This role is responsible for assisting in all operational duties of the Community Manager, including reporting, rent processing, leasing, marketing, and overseeing the community and associates in the Community Manager's absence.


***The incumbent in this role must possess a high degree of professionalism and positive engagement for our residents and the workforce.***


* **An Aptitude for Connecting \-** Must possessa strong sense for creating a sense of community, as well as the drive to go the extra mile to create a positive experience for all residents and staff. Your success and purpose are driven by the relationships that you build within your communities, including vendor partners, regulatory, and social services partnerships. This includes adopting a collaborative approach to create consistent, favorable circumstances that foster success and effectiveness for the Organization and the communities.
* **An Authentic Attitude \-** Consistently demonstrate an open and professional attitude and approach when accessing and resolving resident and staff concerns. This includes, but is not limited to, seeking resources throughout the organization via the organization's support services and senior leadership.
* **An Approach that is positive and Professional** \- Consistently demonstrate an approach of active listening and understand that your participation and support are integral to the success of Avanath, ensuring that each resident and staff member feels seen, heard, and valued as you and the staff work to resolve challenges.


**Qualifications**


* 2\+ years' experience as an Assistant Community Manager.
* LIHTC/Tax Credit Program Knowledge required.
* Equipped with excellent communication skills and an unmatched dedication to customer service.
* Solid track record of bookkeeping and rent collection.
* Thorough understanding of landlord/tenant law.
* Strong Understanding of Fair Housing Laws.
* Superior interpersonal skills: ability to get along with diverse personalities; tactful; mature, flexible.
* Resourceful and organized.
* Solid computer knowledge, Windows (Word, Excel), internet, and e\-mail.
* Working knowledge of Yardi Voyager Property Management software.


**Key Accountabilities**

\+ **Resident Relations \+ Customer Service**


* At all times, regardless, provides A\+ customer service.
* Manages and promotes resident satisfaction and retention by responding to complaints, questions, and requests in a timely manner, and taking appropriate action to resolve and address service issues.
* Functions as a resource center for residents on all things that affect and may disturb their community\-living experience and ability to make timely rent payments.
* Organizes and executes resident appreciation and retention events.
* Maintains a secure, confidential file for each resident.
* Answering phones, greeting walk\-ins, and handling foot traffic.
* Assist with leasing job duties, including touring prospective residents.


\+ **Fiduciary**


* Handles all the monies of the property. Collects, posts, and deposits rents/security deposits and other community income.
* Reviews resident files and ledger records to determine unpaid and/or late fees owed, communicates with residents regarding outstanding balances, implements procedures for collecting on delinquencies, and enforces the lease agreements.
* Assist with Monthly Projection Reporting, inspect vacancies, make\-ready apartments, and models. Inspects the property for community policy violations, needed repairs, and overall landscaping.
* Meets regularly with Community Manager and Regional Manager to discuss community performance.
* Other duties as assigned by Community Manager.


\+ **Staff Leadership**


* Maintains a service\-oriented environment by always exhibiting a professional appearance and attitude.
* Oversees property operations and staff in Community Manager's absence.
* Support Leasing Consultants in the leasing of apartments and ensure that Fair Housing guidelines are followed.
* Under the direction of the Compliance department and the Community Manager, manages compliance file maintenance, where applicable.


\+ **Adherence to Property Management Rules, Regulations, and Guidelines**


* Conduct all business in accordance with company policies and procedures, Fair Housing, *Americans with Disabilities Act,* and all other laws pertaining to the apartment industry.
* Under the direction of the Compliance department and the Community Manager, manages compliance file maintenance, where applicable.
* Follows the Company's established procedures related to evictions by following proper notice requirements, evicting residents, and representing the property as required in court hearings and eviction proceedings.


**Physical Demands \& Working Conditions**

* The incumbent in this position is classified as essential staff and is expected to report to work and adhere to all safety and business protocols.
* Frequent sitting and walking.
* Repetitive use of the computer, keyboard, mouse, and phone.
* Reading, comprehending, writing, performing calculations, and communicating verbally.
* May work in an elevated site, may walk on uneven ground.
* Occasional squatting, bending neck/waist, twisting neck/waist, pushing, and pulling.


**How Avanath Supports You**



We know that our teams are the heart of our success and growth, and we are committed to showing our appreciation.



We offer:


*

jobs.title: Partner Operations Specialist – Ad Ecosystem
jobs.description:
### **Partner Operations Specialist – Ad Ecosystem**


**Location:** Toronto, ON, Canada / Mountain View, CA, US (Hybrid)

Job Type: Contractor, Full Time, Monday \- Friday

#### **Position Overview**


MediaGo is seeking a motivated, detail\-oriented **Partner Operations Specialist** to join our global operations team. In this role, you will serve as a key operational bridge between our global business teams and third\-party technology \& ecosystem verification partners, ensuring the long\-term health, compliance, and operational excellence of our programmatic advertising platform.

This role combines **partner communication, case management, and cross\-functional coordination**. You will be responsible for managing day\-to\-day partner communications, handling ad quality and compliance appeals, establishing standardized escalation trackers, and gathering market intelligence to support sustainable business growth across North America and global markets.  



#### **Key Responsibilities**


**1\. Partner Relationship \& Account Operations**

* Serve as the day\-to\-day operational point of contact for key ecosystem technology, compliance, and measurement partners.
* Organize and lead regular operational check\-ins (weekly/bi\-weekly cadence) to review open cases, platform updates, and service SLAs.
* Foster collaborative, trusted working relationships with external partner teams across North America.

**2\. Case \& Appeal Management (Ad Quality \& Policy)**

* Own the end\-to\-end management of ad compliance appeals, domain whitelisting, and creative scan troubleshooting across top supply and publisher channels.
* Coordinate urgent (P0/P1\) case escalations, investigate root causes with internal stakeholders, and submit well\-documented appeals to external review teams.
* Drive cases to resolution to ensure minimal disruption to live traffic and partner monetization.

**3\. Cross\-Functional Coordination**

* Act as the communication liaison between external partners and internal teams, including Client Management, Business Development, Ad Operations, and Product/Engineering.
* Translate operational feedback and policy guidelines into clear, actionable recommendations for internal account managers and technical teams.

**4\. Tracking \& Ecosystem Intelligence**

* Build and maintain a centralized **Case \& Escalation Tracker** to log issue types, partner responses, resolution times, and recurring root causes.
* Stay up\-to\-date on emerging industry standards, platform policy updates, and brand safety benchmarks, sharing relevant insights with the broader team.
* Proactively explore and build early communication channels with broader industry service providers to prepare for future business needs.

#### **Qualifications \& Requirements**


* **Experience:** 1–3 years of experience in account management, ad operations, partner solutions, customer success, or related client\-facing operational roles (AdTech, digital media, or SaaS experience preferred).
* **Communication Skills:** Excellent verbal and written English communication skills; comfortable presenting issues clearly and professionally to external partner representatives.
* **Language Proficiency:** **Bilingual fluency in English and Mandarin Chinese (written \& spoken)** is strongly preferred to facilitate smooth cross\-border collaboration between North American partners and global engineering/operations teams.
* **Core Competencies:**

	+ High attention to detail with strong organizational and follow\-through capabilities.
	+ Proactive problem\-solver with patience and persistence in managing multi\-step case appeals.
	+ Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, cross\-timezone work environment.
* **Technical Aptitude:** Foundational familiarity with digital advertising concepts (DSP, SSP, programmatic buying, ad serving) is a plus, though deep technical engineering expertise is not required.
* **Education:** Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience.
Hourly Pay Rate Range: $25\-$35/h

jobs.description:
### **Who We Are**



Simpplr is the AI\-powered intranet for unifying the digital workplace. It brings people, trusted knowledge, apps, and agents into a coherent digital experience. Powered by a proprietary EX Knowledge Graph, Simpplr synthesizes signals and context across connected systems to deliver personalized information and actions. The platform serves as a digital hub supporting communications, engagement, employee services, and work. With low\-code extensibility and enterprise\-grade security and governance, Simpplr enables confident operation at scale. More than 1,000 organizations — including AAA, the NHS, Penske, and Moderna — trust Simpplr to keep their workforce informed, aligned, and productive. Learn more at simpplr.com.

### **The Opportunity**



We are looking for a Sales Development Representative to join our team!



At Simpplr, we know that the key to growth is a high\-performing sales team. That’s why we’re seeking a qualified sales development representative (SDR) to find and screen potential customers who could benefit from our products and services. As the first line of communication with a prospect, the ideal SDR has a strong understanding of the sales process and excels at qualifying leads, starting new relationships, and setting up sales closers for success. The SDR should be a quick learner who has strong communication skills and an ability to showcase our offerings compellingly. Every potential customer is an opportunity for boosting top\-line revenue growth, customer acquisition levels, and profitability.


### **Your Job Responsibilities**


#### **What you will be doing:**


* Efficiently respond and qualify inbound marketing leads, reaching out with urgency and contacting leads in 10 minutes or less
* Generate new business opportunities to fuel the sales pipeline
* Call, Email, and use social touches to follow up with Inbound Marketing Leads promptly
* Engage in conversation to qualify inbound marketing leads based on qualification criteria.
* Evangelize Simpplr both internally and through your inbound efforts
* Achieve monthly quotas of sales accepted opportunities and sales qualified opportunities (Stage 2 \& Stage 4\)

### **Your Skillset**


#### **What makes you a great fit for our team:**


* Have an interest in sales, a sales background, or 0\-6 months of SDR experience
* Proven track record of quota and KPI attainment
* A driven individual who thrives on success and winning
* You have demonstrated strong verbal and written communication skills including responding to inquiries both on the phone and via email
* Demonstrated strong problem\-solving skills to help decode a prospect's pain points through a short conversation
* You have been able to learn, from formalized instruction and also self\-discovery, how to best present the benefits of the product you are selling
* Ability to understand customer needs and meet those needs with a successful product sale
* Shown excellent time management skills and the ability to work in an efficient manner


Our job titles may span more than one career level. The starting base pay for this role is between $57,000 \- $65,000\. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity and benefits.



Simpplr is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or genetics.



\#LI\-HYBRID


Pay Range


$57,000 \- $65,000 USD

### **Your Voice, Unfiltered:**



We value the real you. To ensure a fair and authentic experience for everyone, we ask that you do not use AI tools (such as real\-time answer generators, transcription apps, or note\-taking bots) during your interview



Our process is designed to hear your unique story, thought process, and lived experience in real\-time. Use of unauthorized AI tools may result in disqualification, as we want to ensure every candidate is evaluated on their own individual merits. We’re excited to meet the person behind the resume!



If you need assistive technology or AI tools for accessibility (e.g., live captioning), please notify your recruiter in advance. We are committed to providing an inclusive interview experience.

  

### **Simpplr’s Hub\-Hybrid\-Remote Model:**



At Simpplr we believe that when work is good, life is better and that belief guides all we do. Including how we approach our flexible work model. Simpplr operates with a Hub\-Hybrid\-Remote model. This model is role\-based with exceptions and provides employees with the flexibility that many have told us they want.


* **Hub \-** **100% work from Simpplr office.** Role requires Simpplifier to be in the office full\-time.
* **Hybrid \-** **Hybrid work from home and office.** Role dictates the ability to work from home, plus benefit from in\-person collaboration on a regular basis.
* **Remote \- 100% remote.** Role can be done anywhere within your country of hire, as long as the requirements of the role are met.

**POSITION DETAILS**


The Administrative Coordinator will report to the chair of the Department of Architecture in the Spitzer School of Architecture at the City College of New York. This position will provide administrative and coordination support for departmental projects and initiatives, including activities related to new graduate programs, the preparation, execution and administration of new programs for assessment, the maintenance of confidential records, and the coordination of department planning with the dean’s office as well as projects originating from the chair’s office.


The SSA is committed to social and sustainable concerns in design and practice, as well as to providing access to the finest education in the art, history, and technology of architecture, landscape architecture, urban design, and urban studies to the broadest and most diverse student population. A prospective member of the staff should be prepared to participate in and contribute to this lively intellectual atmosphere, and join the SSA in its commitment in furthering justice, equity, diversity, inclusion, and anti\-racism within the academy and the design professions.


In addition to the CUNY Title Overview, the duties of the Administrative Coordinator include but are not limited to the following:


* Provide administrative support for program assessment and accreditation activities, including preparing and maintaining documentation required for professional accreditation in architecture and landscape architecture;
* Review, update, and maintain confidential faculty records;
* Provide administrative and coordination support for departmental planning activities in collaboration with the Dean’s Office;
* Support the department chair in administration and operations, provide continuity and preserve institutional knowledge;
* Coordinate and track departmental projects and initiatives, including activities related to community outreach and cross campus collaboration; under the direction of the Department Chair;
* Provide reports and updates on department projects, including potential completion dates and information regarding the progress and effectiveness of new initiatives.

Administrative \& Program Coordinator

The Administrative \& Program Coordinator provides administrative, program, development, and governance support to the Executive Director and contributes to the effective day\-to\-day operation of Riverdale Senior Services (RSS). The position supports contract and grant administration, fundraising activities, Board and committee coordination, transportation services, invoice reconciliation, and general office operations. The Administrative \& Program Coordinator works with senior leadership, Board members, funders, staff, vendors, older adult members, and community partners while maintaining a high level of confidentiality and professionalism.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail\-oriented, able to manage multiple priorities, and comfortable working independently and collaboratively. Working knowledge of social media, nonprofit operations, and programs serving older adults is preferred. This position reports directly to the Executive Director.

Key Responsibilities1\. Administrative Support

* Provide administrative and organizational support to the Executive Director.
* Assist with the preparation, submission, tracking, monitoring, and compliance of contracts and grants.
* Coordinate monthly staff meetings, including scheduling, agendas, meeting materials, and summaries as requested.
* Coordinate and provide administrative support for Board and committee meetings, including scheduling, meeting invitations and reminders, preparation and distribution of agendas and materials, meeting logistics, and maintenance of meeting records. Serve as a liaison among the Executive Director, staff, Board members, and committee chairs to facilitate communication and follow\-up.
* Support the Executive Director and Deputy Director with special projects, research, correspondence, and organizational initiatives.

2\. Development \& Fundraising

* Assist with the coordination and administration of fundraising events, campaigns, and development initiatives.

4\. Office Operations \& Financial Administration

* Review and reconcile monthly invoices from contracted consultants and service providers against contracts, approved services, and supporting documentation.

* Assist with coordination and communication with community partners, vendors, and other external stakeholders.
* Participate in agency\-wide initiatives, special events, and organizational projects.
* Support departments and staff with administrative and operational needs as required.
* Perform other duties as assigned in support of the mission and goals of Riverdale Senior Services.

Preferred Skills \& Qualifications

* Strong administrative, organizational, and time\-management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Experience supporting senior leadership, Boards, committees, programs, or nonprofit organizations.
* Experience coordinating transportation, scheduling, vendors, or member services preferred.
* Experience with invoice review, reconciliation, financial recordkeeping, or administrative financial processes preferred.
* Familiarity with fundraising CRM databases and basic development operations.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and follow\-through.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and online scheduling and collaboration tools.
* Experience with NYC contracting and procurement systems preferred.
* Working knowledge of social media platforms and nonprofit communications preferred.
* Ability to handle confidential information with discretion and professionalism.
* Ability to work independently while also functioning effectively as part of a team.
* Dependable, professional, and committed to providing high\-quality administrative and program support.
* Commitment to the mission of senior services and community\-based nonprofit work.

Salary \& Benefits

The salary range for this position is **$55,000 – $65,000 annually**, commensurate with experience and qualifications.

jobs.company: It Takes A Village Youth Services
jobs.title: Program Coordinator – Recess Coach (Brooklyn)
jobs.description:
**Turn Recess Into Something Kids Look Forward To!** ⚽

Program Coordinator – Recess Coach

**Love working with kids? Enjoy sports, games, movement, and bringing positive energy wherever you go?**

ITAV is looking for energetic, dependable, and enthusiastic **Program Coordinators – Recess Coaches** to help us transform recess into a fun, safe, inclusive, and meaningful part of the school day.

This isn't a job where you simply stand on the sidelines and watch.

You'll be **leading games, getting kids moving, encouraging teamwork, helping students work through conflicts, building confidence, and creating the kind of recess experience students can't wait to be part of.**

If you love working with young people and believe play can be a powerful way to teach leadership, communication, teamwork, and confidence — **we want to meet you!**

**Who We Are**

**ITAV** is a sports\-based youth development organization that uses sports, fitness, structured play, and engaging activities to help young people build confidence, communication skills, leadership, accountability, and positive relationships.

We believe kids learn some of life's most important lessons while they're moving, playing, competing, communicating, and having fun.

What You'll Be Doing

As a **Program Coordinator – Recess Coach**, you'll help bring energy, structure, and FUN to the school day.

**You'll:**

* Lead fun, age\-appropriate sports, games, and movement activities.
* Get students excited about participating — including kids who may not usually join in.
* Encourage teamwork, communication, sportsmanship, and fair play.
* Help students build confidence and leadership skills through play.
* Help students work through disagreements and practice healthy conflict resolution.
* Create an environment where every child feels welcomed and included.
* Actively supervise students and keep activities safe, organized, and engaging.
* Adapt games and activities to support students with different abilities and needs.
* Build positive relationships with teachers, school staff, students, and the ITAV team.
* Respond appropriately to student concerns, injuries, incidents, or unexpected situations.
* Support field days, special events, after\-school activities, and other ITAV programs when needed.

**You'll Be Great at This If You...**

* Genuinely enjoy working with children and young people.
* Bring positive energy into a room — or onto a playground!
* Aren't afraid to jump into a game and participate.
* Can confidently lead and engage groups of children.
* Know how to be fun **and** maintain appropriate boundaries.
* Are patient, dependable, responsible, and professional.
* Communicate well with children and adults.
* Can stay calm when things don't go exactly as planned.
* Believe every child should have an opportunity to participate and feel successful.
* Enjoy being part of a team.

What We're Looking For

**Required:**

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Experience working with children or youth.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to lead games, activities, and groups of students.
* Ability to work both independently and collaboratively.
* Dependability and punctuality.
* Ability to work in active indoor and outdoor environments.

**Even Better If You Have:**

* Experience as a coach, camp counselor, recreation specialist, group leader, school aide, paraprofessional, or after\-school instructor.
* Experience working with students with disabilities or behavioral support needs.
* Sports, fitness, recreation, or youth development experience.
* Knowledge of positive behavior management or conflict\-resolution strategies.
* CPR or First Aid certification.

**This Role Is Active!**

You won't spend your day sitting behind a desk.

You'll be walking, moving, demonstrating games, setting up activities, interacting with students, and spending time indoors and outdoors.

If you enjoy an active workday, this may be a great fit.

**Why Join ITAV?**

Because **recess is more than free time.**

It's where kids can learn to communicate.

It's where they practice teamwork.

It's where confidence grows.

It's where new friendships happen.

And sometimes, it's where a young person discovers that they're a leader.

At ITAV, you'll have an opportunity to make those moments happen every day.

Ready to Bring the Energy?

If you're ready to **move, motivate, mentor, and make an impact**, we'd love to hear from you.

**Apply today and help ITAV create playgrounds and programs where every child has an opportunity to play, connect, grow, and thrive!**

Pay: $18\.00 \- $20\.00 per hour

Work Location: In person
