jobs.description:
**Program Coordinator**


The Program Director is responsible for the oversight of a school\-based after\-school program. The Program Coordinator provides leadership, direction, supervision, and support to program staff to ensure desired program goals and outcomes are met. The Program Director serves as the primary contact between NIA and the school principal, and represents NIA to the whole school community. The Program Director will report to a Program Supervisor and will work with assigned supervisor to create a dynamic after\-school program that includes academic enrichment, project based learning, arts, sports, and leadership activities.

**Duties and Responsibilities:**




* Supervise all aspects of a school\-based after\-school program
* Manage daily operations and coordinate with the schools administration, teachers, secretaries, and custodial staff
* Organize program logistics, such as schedules, lesson plan collection, snack and space reservations, trips, supply requests, and programmatic needs
* Build relationships with the school principal and administrative team to facilitate seamless integration of NIA staff and expanded hours into the overall school culture
* Build and maintain positive relationships with all stakeholders (participants, parents, school staff and administration, funders, the community, and NIA)
* Ensure that the program operates in compliance with all DOH and funder regulations and meets all contractual obligations, specifically in the area of enrollment and rate of participation
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date attendance data and meet deadlines for data entry into database
* Assist in the interviewing, managing, training, and coaching of program staff and volunteers
* Conduct classroom observations; assess and evaluate staff on a consistent basis and address concerns as they arise
* Maintain accurate time and attendance records for all staff, current staff and student files, incident and accident reports, and other required documentation and student data
* Review lesson plans weekly; support the development of curriculum maps and activity plans
* Ensure program content supports initiative goals and outcomes
* Participate in school leadership committees and PTA meetings
* Work closely with families, parents, and guardians to ensure the needs of students are met
* Create a strong sense of community which values respect, acceptance, and high expectations
* Perform other duties and tasks as deemed necessary by the NIA

**Qualifications and Requirements:**

* A minimum of a Bachelors degree related to education or youth development
* A minimum of four years of relevant experience working with children in an educational setting is preferred
* At least two years experience supervising staff and managing programs is preferred
* Strong leadership, conflict\-resolution and diplomacy skills
* Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, ability to prioritize, meet deadlines and multitask in a fast\-paced environment
* Capacity to work independently and collaboratively
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Computer proficiency including Microsoft Word and Excel, email correspondence, and database management is required
* Familiarity with NY State Standards
* Must be available to work Monday through Friday, between the hours of 10:00 am and 6:00 pm
* Must take part in 30 hours of professional development opportunities per year and be available for some organization events outside of regular business hours

**Overview of the Function**


The Communications Coordinator role sits within the global brand \& communications function with strong links to the US marketing and business development team. This role is focused on supporting the firm’s market positioning and brand in the US as well as its business development objectives as a key contributor on the US comms team.

**Role summary/purpose of job**


The Communications Coordinator works under the daily guidance of the US communications lead to provide planning, content development, coordination, reporting, and operational support across the Brand \& Communications function. The role supports the development and execution of internal and external communications initiatives that strengthen employee engagement, enhance the firm’s reputation and brand, and support overall growth objectives. Responsibilities include internal communications, media relations, thought leadership, social media, content management, measurement, communications operations and award \& recognition submissions.

**Key responsibilities and deliverables**

* Support the planning, coordination, execution and measurement of communications and brand initiatives across the US business.
* Assist with media relations activities, including drafting press releases and media materials, maintaining media lists, preparing briefing materials and supporting deal publicity.
* Support thought leadership and external positioning initiatives through content development, media outreach and campaign coordination.
* Coordinate award, ranking and recognition submissions where appropriate, including maintaining submission calendars and drafting supporting content.
* Assist with social media activities, including content creation, publishing support, campaign coordination and performance tracking as needed.
* Draft and distribute internal communications, including leadership messages, employee announcements, intranet content, newsletters and town hall communications.
* Support employee engagement campaigns and internal communication initiatives in partnership with HR, leadership and other business functions.
* Maintain communications calendars and help ensure alignment across internal and external communications activities.
* Monitor and report on communications performance, including media coverage, employee engagement, email communications, social media activity and other key metrics.
* Support the maintenance of communications and marketing collateral, digital content and selected web pages as needed.
* Provide administrative and operational support for communications projects, campaigns and events as needed.
* Build strong working relationships with lawyers, business services teams and firm leadership to support communications priorities.
* Undertake additional communications\-related responsibilities as required.

**Key requirements** **(Communication/skills/experience)**

* Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Journalism, Marketing, or English preferred
* 1\-3 years of relevant PR/communications experience; PR/communications agency experience a plus
* Outstanding verbal and written communication skills (proficient in AP Style a plus)
* Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail
* Highly proficient in Microsoft office applications and AI use.

Under the supervision of the Principal, the Community Coordinator will perform duties related to developing and improving community relations. The Community Coordinator will support the school in its efforts to increase and maintain communication between the school and our students, families, staff, and community partners and other community organizations and high schools and colleges. The Community Coordinator will similarly work to develop and sustain positive relations with other schools in the community and other organizations within the NYC Department of Education. jobs.description:
Description:
**Organization Information**


GrowNYC is a 56\-year\-old environmental nonprofit organization helping more than 3 million New Yorkers by providing essential services and taking action to make NYC a livable city, one where every person can enjoy a healthier, more sustainable life. GrowNYC Programs include:

* Our network of Greenmarkets and the work of GrowNYC Wholesale ensure that all New Yorkers have access to the freshest, healthiest local food.
* We build and support community and school gardens through volunteer days, technical assistance, training, grants and more.
* We provide 70,000 children each year with programs that provide meaningful interactions with the natural environment.

**Media Relations Coordinator (Full\-time):**

**Position Summary**


GrowNYC’s Media Relations Coordinator executes social media strategy and policy for GrowNYC. The incumbent is responsible for the organization’s central accounts and providing guidance to the Advancement Team and programs that have a social media presence. In collaboration with the Director of Advancement and Communications Lead, the Media Relations Coordinator will help shape communications strategy on social media, drive community engagement, and protect the organization’s brand, ensuring that GrowNYC’s voice is maintained across all digital channels.


Requirements:
**Responsibilities (include but are not limited to):**

***Digital Strategy and Content Creation***

* Develop and execute digital and social media communication plans and strategy that is tailored to multiple audiences and amplifies multimedia communications and drives stakeholder engagement across all GrowNYC channels and is designed to influence public opinion.
* Oversee social media content and calendar.
* Ensure that GrowNYC press coverage is amplified through social media and promote GrownNYC’s organization, programs, and services in a timely fashion.
* Execute GrowNYC’s paid social media advertising and conceptualize digital campaigns to support fundraising goals in collaboration with Advancement Team.
* Receive and review internal directives and informational materials to help ensure digital media communications are always informed by and representative of GrowNYC’s current organizational objectives, policies, and goals.
* Plan and create custom communications and content for publication through digital channels in collaboration with various GrowNYC programs. This includes recording and editing short\-form video content for social media.
* Interface with corporate sponsors to fulfill sponsorship agreements in collaboration with Corporate Partnerships Lead.
* Oversee and manage the organization’s online presence while maintaining its continuity across digital media platforms and ensuring rollout is according to schedule and drives engagement and brand awareness.

***Training and Analytics***

* Maintain and improve social media best practices for GrowNYC and help train other communicators on these practices.
* Work directly with other program teams to coordinate the production and publishing of various digital communication platforms: (written, video, audio, photo)
* Build relationships across GrowNYC’s content creators and team members to foster collaboration, ensure message and brand alignment, and increase engagement/reach of our digital efforts.
* Establish KPIs and ensure we are optimizing engagement and broadening the reach of digital marketing/fundraising efforts.
* Track, monitor, and review campaign performance based on data and analytics pertaining to Return on Investment (ROI) and other Key Performance Indicators (KPI).
* Ensure all content on GrowNYC social media channels do not run afoul of GrowNYC's 501c3 status.
* Develop, implement, and share within the organization’s search engine optimization and search engine marketing best practices that drive audience engagement.
* Conduct market research and audience segmentation to increase digital user base, increase brand awareness, and stay up to date on social media trends and practices.
* Conduct robust community engagement and social listening.

**Required Qualifications**

* Master’s degree in media management, public relations or related field of study and 6 months of experience in organic social media content development and community management as social media coordinator or related occupation.
* Knowledge of media relations and public relations communication practices, ability to develop and distribute media and digital content across social media platforms
* Ability to monitor and analyze digital and social media performance using analytics tools (e.g. Google Analytics or equivalent), proficiency with digital content creation tools (e.g. Adobe Photoshop, Canva, or equivalent).
* Proficiency in Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, Twitter, Canva and LinkedIn
* Excellent communication skills, both oral and written
* Proven success in social media campaign planning, management and reporting
* Creative thinker and storyteller who can conceptualize and create content that reinforces brand
* Capability to analyze data and make actionable data driven goals
* Demonstrated high attention to detail and personal organization
* Strong interpersonal skills and collaborative work style
* Self\-starting attitude with an ability to problem solve

**Ideal Qualifications**

* Interest in urban environmental and food systems is a plus
* Working experience with influencer marketing is desired

**Physical Requirements**


Ability to be seated for long periods of time.

**Schedule**


This role is required to work 35\-40 hours per week, Monday to Friday.

This position is full\-time, non\-exempt with a salary of $75,254 and includes full benefits (medical, dental, vision, life insurance, long\-term disability, incentive savings plan, paid time off, Public Service Loan Forgiveness, and potential for parental leave for full\-time regular employees who have been employed with GrowNYC for 175 day

jobs.title: Account Coordinator, Agency Operations
jobs.description:
FINN Partners’ Travel practice is a multi\-million\-dollar global powerhouse representing the world’s most prestigious established and emerging brands. Comprising both the global reach of **FINN Travel** and the boutique, culture\-shifting expertise of **Maverick Creative**, our team sits at the intersection of luxury, travel, and lifestyle.


We are seeking an **Account Coordinator, Agency Operations** who is hungry to launch a career in communications. This is not a traditional administrative role; it is a "front\-row seat" to the inner workings of a global agency. You will partner directly with our executive team, providing the operational backbone that keeps our leadership and team thriving.


This role offers a unique dual\-perspective: while serving as the operational engine for our leadership team, you will simultaneously gain direct insight into the high\-level strategy and decision\-making that drives a global agency. Mentorship is built into the fabric of this position, offering daily exposure to the inner workings of travel and lifestyle communications alongside seasoned industry leaders.


This role is designed as a launchpad: we are looking for someone eager to learn the business from the top down and transition into a full\-time PR and account\-facing career within our team. While this role begins with a heavy focus on operations and administrative support, successful candidates will be integrated into account brainstorms and client projects as they master the agency's operational foundations.


This role is based out of New York office and is a hybrid schedule with 2 days a week in person.**Responsibilities:**

### **Meeting, Event \& Team Coordination**

* Enable seamless agency collaboration by coordinating in\-office and virtual meetings from end to end, ensuring rooms, technology, materials, and catering are prepared so teams can stay focused, productive, and client\-ready.
* Strengthen agency culture and team engagement by planning and supporting internal events, trainings, and team gatherings that bring employees together, encourage professional development, and create a consistent, well\-executed employee experience.
* Champion agency culture by overseeing the team’s monthly calendar—tracking key industry events, team milestones, and internal training sessions to keep our team sharp and connected.

**Recruiting \& Onboarding Support**

* Schedule interviews and manage candidate logistics
* Assist with onboarding coordination to ensure a smooth and welcoming experience
* Maintain recruiting trackers and organize candidate materials

**Presentation \& Materials Development**

* Support the new business pitch process by assisting in the creation of visually stunning decks and research materials for prospective luxury and lifestyle clients. A strength in PowerPoint and Canva design is critical for this role.

**Project Coordination \& Operations Support**

* Maintain shared documents, trackers, and team resources
* Support project coordination by tracking timelines, milestones, and dependencies
* Identify opportunities to improve organization, workflows, and internal processes

**Client\-Ready Communication**

* Draft and support executive briefings, summaries, and presentations
* Ensure all written materials are polished, clear, and aligned with brand voice and tone

**Social Media \& Digital Support**

* Support our internal and external brand presence on LinkedIn and Instagram, ensuring the FINN Travel and Maverick Creative voices remain at the forefront of the industry.

**Qualifications**

* **0–2 years of experience** (Internships in PR, Marketing, or luxury hospitality are a major plus).
* Exceptional organizational skills and strong attention to detail
* Clear, professional written and verbal communication skills
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (PowerPoint, Excel), Google Workspace, and Canva
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment
* **A "No Task Too Small" Attitude:** You understand that managing a calendar or a room setup is just as vital to winning a new account as the new business pitch itself.
* **High Aesthetic IQ:** A natural eye for design and detail, specifically within the Canva and PowerPoint environments.
* A proactive, solutions\-oriented mindset with strong follow\-through
* **Discretion \& Professionalism:** Ability to interface with high\-level executives and global brand partners with confidence and polish.

**The salary** **range for this role is $48,000\-$53,000\.**  

  

**About FINN Partners**


FINN Partners is one of the fastest\-growing independent marketing and communications agencies in the world. Our Travel practice represents some of the most exciting destinations, hotels, and brands globally, and our team is known for its collaborative spirit, entrepreneurial mindset, and commitment to excellence.

Working closely with the Manager of Marketing Strategy and collaborating with cross\-functional teams, you will help coordinate campaign deliverables, monitor performance, and ensure marketing initiatives are executed efficiently.


This is a great opportunity for someone who is organized, eager to learn, and passionate about marketing. The ideal candidate is a strong communicator with excellent project coordination skills, enjoys working in a collaborative and fast\-paced environment, understands the technical application of multi\-channel marketing campaigns, and has a keen eye for detail.

* Support the planning, coordination, and execution of multi\-channel marketing campaigns that support firm’s business priorities.
* Gather, log, and monitor performance metrics to track campaign goals and KPIs.
* Opportunity to take ownership of base\-level marketing plans, manage timelines and deliverables, and execute strategy from kick\-off to completion.
* Assist the Manager of Marketing Strategy and Marketing Strategy Specialist with higher tier campaigns by coordinating tasks, preparing campaign assets, and tracking progress.
* Assist with the creation and editing of marketing content for digital, print, and video materials.
* Coordinate email marketing efforts, including drafting, scheduling, and performance tracking of email campaigns.
* Participate in team meetings, brainstorming sessions, and post\-campaign reviews, contributing ideas and documenting key takeaways.
* Maintain campaign calendars and coordinate with Marketing Operations Team for workflow tracking within project management systems.

**Who You Are:**

* 2\+ years of marketing, communications, or related experience, including internships or professional experience.
* Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, business, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* Experience working in professional services is a plus but not essential – we welcome applications from all backgrounds.
* Familiarity with digital marketing platforms (Google Analytics, Sprout Social, Parse.ly, Clarity, Dynamics) and project management tools (Workfront) is preferred; willingness to learn is essential.
* Proficient within the Microsoft Office Suite in a PC environment
* Experience working with email platforms (Dynamics; Stripo) is a plus.
* An organized and detail\-oriented team player who thrives in a collaborative environment.
* Comfortable juggling multiple projects and deadlines with a positive attitude.
* Curious, proactive, and eager to learn new marketing tools and best practices.
* A strong communicator who approaches work with professionalism and excellence.
* Adaptable, resourceful, and solutions\-oriented, with a willingness to take initiative and continuously improve.
* Passionate about marketing and excited to grow a career in marketing strategy.

jobs.title: Operations Associate
jobs.description:
Kotn is looking for a BOH (back\-of\-house) Associate to support the efficient operation of our store’s back\-end processes. As an essential part of the Retail Operations team, you will ensure all inventory, deliveries, and stockroom activities are handled accurately and efficiently. This is an exciting opportunity, integral to the growth and success of Kotn’s Retail Business.


### **What you’ll be working on:**


**Stockroom \& Logistics Operations (40%)**


* Handle deliveries and shipments, including scheduling and tracking shipments
* Assist with the preparation of inventory audits and regular stock counts
* Ensure compliance with health, safety, and cleanliness standards in the stockroom and storage areas
* Monitor product quality, report damaged goods, and handle returns or defective products
* Receive, unpack, and organize merchandise
* Monitor and maintain the stockroom by organizing products and supplies
* Ensure timely and accurate restocking of merchandise on the sales floor
* Prepare merchandise for floor sets

**Supporting the Sales Floor (30%)**


* Provide the sales team with quick and accurate information regarding stock availability
* Ensure products are available for customers when needed
* Run product from BOH to FOH to support customer purchases and restocking
* Be customer\-focused, and prepared to support customer service and sales at all times i.e. operate the cash register, greet customers, support customers in the fitting room, etc.

**Visual Merchandising (30%)**


* Provide the sales team with quick and accurate information regarding stock availability
* Execute early morning and late evening store merchandising

**What you’ll bring:**


* Strong ability to manage multiple tasks, organize stock, and meet deadlines efficiently.
* Excellent eye for detail when handling inventory to ensure accuracy in stock management.
* Collaborates well with others to maintain stockroom efficiency and ensure smooth coordination with the sales team.
* Ability to identify and resolve inventory discrepancies or stock issues quickly and effectively

**Additional Requirements:**


* Previous experience in a retail or stockroom role (preferred)
* Ability to lift and carry heavy boxes, as required by company needs
* Basic computer skills for managing inventory systems
* Flexible schedule with weekend availability

**Our Perks:**


Clothing Allowance: Kotn team members are given an annual clothing allowance and discount.


**Equal Employment Opportunity:**


KOTN Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where all employees feel valued, respected, and empowered to contribute to our mission.

KOTN Inc. is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you require accommodation during the application or interview process, please notify the hiring manager of the role.


**The hourly rate for this position is $18\.00–$20\.00, based on experience and qualifications.**

jobs.title: Customer Success Associate
jobs.description:
Runwise is looking for an entry\-level **Customer Success Associate** who is highly motivated, results\-oriented, and looking to learn about Customer Success and the SaaS/PropTech industry.



Runwise (www.runwise.com) is a fast\-paced, customer\-focused New York City / Boston based energy tech startup that controls and runs the heating systems in nearly 8000 buildings throughout the United States. Runwise's unique hardware and software service significantly reduces energy usage, substantially lowering costs and carbon output. The average reduction in energy use across those buildings was 21%. Together, those buildings saved more than $44 million in energy costs to date.



As a Customer Success Associate at Runwise you will have the opportunity to work directly with our Customer Success Managers. Each customer and each building has unique needs. You will assist our Customer Success Managers, helping them effectively manage their books of business while you learn our product and services. You will be an integral part of our customer experience, helping our customers run their heating systems in an energy efficient way that makes tenants more comfortable.


**Responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:**


* Assisting property managers, supers, and owners with the Runwise platform
* Drafting and delivering savings reports for existing customers
* Pulling reports and reviewing customer data to distill trends, flag inconsistencies, etc.
* Reviewing customer dashboards, usage, etc. to help identify trends and triggers to escalate to Customer Success Managers
* Proactively identifying potential problems that may lead to reduced savings or a miss on customer goals
* Assisting Customer Success Managers in building relationships with all parties interested in the Runwise product (supers, property managers, owners)
* Managing internal CRM tools, maintaining customer data hygiene, and executing playbooks
* Engaging with clients directly and facilitating ongoing adoption of product and platform utilization
* Working cross\-functionally to maintain customer records, signals, and data


**Who you are:**


* You have 0\-1 years of direct customer management experience in a Customer Success, Support or Account Management role or are interested in learning about the Customer Success space
* You have excellent social and communication skills and find it easy to get along with others
* You are pro\-active, detail\-oriented, extremely organized and you have strong project management skills
* You thrive by building long\-term relationships and partnering with a range of stakeholders (customers, colleagues, etc.)
* You are a problem solver and can help diagnose and troubleshoot problems quickly and efficiently.
* You are always looking for ways to do the job faster and better, including using AI tools to boost productivity and streamline repetitive internal processes and tasks
* You are eager to learn and grow in your abilities. Over time you will help to distill technical or complex systems into simpler concepts to empower customers
* You are willing and capable of working very hard and at times longer hours during peak season (winter)
* You are passionate about real estate and/or energy efficiency
* Bilingual English/Spanish skills are definite plus, but not a prerequisite


Runwise is proud to be an equal\-opportunity employer. We are committed to equal opportunity for all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other legally protected characteristics. We celebrate and support diverse perspectives, skills, and experiences within our company.:



Salary: **$70,000\-$80,000** (varied on experience and market rate)


**What you believe:**


* No job is too small.
* Sincerity builds trust.
* Setbacks fuel progress.
* Efficiency is vital.


**Benefits:**


* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* HSA \& FSA options
* Paid Parental Leave
* Access to Talkspace \& Health Advocate
* Flexible PTO
* Commuter Benefits
* 401K
* Company paid life insurance
* Voluntary supplemental life insurance
* Free in\-office lunch on Wednesdays
* Hybrid work environment
* Summer Fridays
* Monthly L\&D Series
* Employee Resource Groups (e.g. DEIB Committee, Run Club)


***This is an excellent opportunity to join a fast\-growing company and create a career path beyond this initial role. You will be surrounded by talented people where you will learn about real estate and software/managed services sales at a very fast growing tech company, whilst having a tangible impact on reducing carbon emissions across the country.***

jobs.title: Sales Coordinator
jobs.description:
Connell Equipment Leasing Company (CELCO) is seeking a Sales Coordinator to support our Remarketing and Equipment Sales team. This position plays a critical role in keeping our operation running smoothly by coordinating sales support activities, maintaining data integrity, supporting accounting and reporting functions, and serving as a trusted resource to both internal teams and external customers.

We believe long\-term success is built through strong partnerships, operational excellence, and a commitment to exceptional service. If you enjoy bringing structure to complex processes, supporting high\-performing teams, and contributing to a respected organization within the equipment leasing industry, we'd love to hear from you. **How You'll Make an Impact**

* Coordinate day\-to\-day administrative, operational, and sales support activities for the Equipment Sales and Remarketing team, ensuring the efficient execution of departmental priorities.

* Support invoicing, billing, payment tracking, accounts receivable activities, and other accounting\-related administrative processes.
* Generate and maintain reports utilizing Salesforce, Microsoft Excel, and other business systems to support operational efficiency and informed decision\-making.
* Coordinate with customers, vendors, and internal stakeholders to facilitate timely communication, exceptional service, and accurate information sharing.
* Identify opportunities to streamline processes, improve workflows, and enhance departmental efficiency while maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
* Support special projects and additional operational, administrative, and sales support initiatives as needed to achieve departmental and organizational objectives.

**What Sets You Apart**

* Three (3\) or more years of foundational experience in sales operations, accounting support, contract administration, business coordination, customer service, or related operational functions within equipment leasing, finance, logistics, manufacturing, transportation, or similar business environments preferred.
* Demonstrated experience supporting business operations through reporting, documentation management, data administration, process coordination, or customer support activities.
* Working proficiency in Microsoft Excel and experience utilizing Salesforce or comparable CRM systems to support reporting, data integrity, workflow management, and business operations.
* Strong administrative and accounting support acumen, including experience with invoicing, billing, accounts receivable tracking, payment reconciliation, and financial documentation.
* Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, projects, and stakeholder requests in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to build relationships, provide exceptional customer service, and collaborate effectively across departments.
* Demonstrated ability to identify process improvements, solve problems independently, exercise sound judgment, and maintain a high degree of accuracy and attention to detail.
* Adaptable and resourceful professional with a proactive approach to supporting team success and achieving operational objectives.

We believe long\-term success is built through trust, accountability, and meaningful partnerships with our customers and our employees. If you're seeking an opportunity to build relationships, contribute to a growing business, and represent a respected organization, **we'd love to hear from you.**

While we leverage technology to support our recruiting process, every application is personally reviewed by a member of our Human Resources department because we recognize that behind every resume is a person, a career journey, and a genuine interest in joining our organization.

CELCO is an equal opportunity employer and considers all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local law.

Pay: $72,000\.00 \- $76,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Dental insurance

* Paid time off
* Retirement plan

Application Question(s):

* Do you have working proficiency in Microsoft Excel and experience utilizing Salesforce or a comparable CRM system to support reporting, data integrity, workflow management, and business operations?

**Who We Are:**


SiriusXM and its brands (Pandora, SiriusXM Media, AdsWizz, Simplecast, and SiriusXM Connect) are leading a new era of audio entertainment and services by delivering the most compelling subscription and ad\-supported audio entertainment experience for listeners \- in the car, at home, and anywhere on the go with connected devices. Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72\+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

=====================

We are seeking a committed professional to join our team. While this is a remote position not located at a physical Medtronic site, the candidate hired will be required to reside within the territory and drive to multiple accounts throughout the region. A valid driver's license is essential for this role.  

As one of three comprehensive portfolios at Medtronic, Neuroscience is dedicated to improving the lives of people living with neurological disorders, spine conditions, and chronic pain. Guided by our Mission—to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life—we develop technologies and therapies that help people regain function, reduce pain, and return to the activities that matter most.


Our Cranial \& Spinal Technologies (CST) Operating Unit develops and delivers an integrated ecosystem of spinal implants, navigation and robotic guidance systems, advanced imaging, and data\-driven planning tools for complex spine and cranial procedures. Platforms such as AiBLE™ connect these technologies to enhance surgical precision, streamline workflows, and support improved patient outcomes across the globe.


Check us out on LinkedIn: Medtronic CST


At Medtronic, the Sales Representative I, Spine is responsible for soliciting orders, selling Medtronic Spinal products assigned and representing the company in accordance with its policies and in the area assigned; for maintaining an awareness of local competitive conditions. This position will work in tandem with Spine Sales Representatives II and will have territory coverage responsibility and limited sales responsibility. Allocation guideline for core responsibilities include: Inventory Management, Case Coverage, and Selling (outside the operating room).


This is a **field based** role.


Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:


* Maintain, manage and track Consignments and Loaner inventory.
* Keep non usage and flight usage to a minimum level.
* Territory case coverage.
* Manage accounts in assigned territory.
* Prepare and submit call reports as required by the District Sales Manager.
* Maintain up\-to\-date customer record books and other records in accordance with District Sales Manager’s instructions.
* Aggressively solicit orders from present and prospective customers for the products assigned.
* Aggressively seek new customers and formulate and follow plans for such action as directed by the District Sales Manager.
* Resolve customer complaints in accordance with Medtronic Spinal policies and advise District Sales Manager and Medtronic Spinal promptly of any situation beyond scope of authority.
* Recommend the additions of new products and the modification or deletion of present products to the line as appropriate.
* Successful completion of all required product and sales related training curriculum.
* Meet or exceed sales quota and total company market share in assigned territory.
* Attend and participate in sales meetings, training programs and conventions as directed.
* Identify selling opportunities and work closely with the sales representative to increase sales in their respective accounts.
* Comply with all Medtronic Spinal policies.
* Work weekends, evenings, and Holidays as required on an emergency basis.

We seek out and hire a diverse workforce at every level: We need fresh ideas and inclusive insights to continue to be an innovative industry leader —that’s why we make it a point to seek out, attract and develop employees who are patient\-centric, passionate, and who represent the same wide variety of life experiences as our patients.


To learn more about Inclusion \& Diversity at Medtronic Click Here


**Qualifications**
==================

**Must Have: Minimum Requirements**
-----------------------------------

*To be considered for this role, please ensure the minimum requirements are evident in your applicant profile.*

* High School Diploma (or equivalent) AND 4\+ years of experience\*
* OR Associate’s Degree AND 2\+ years of experience\*
* OR Bachelor’s Degree

* Relevant sales, clinical, or related experience in medical devices, medtech, healthcare, or life sciences

**Nice to Have: Preferences**

* Ability to interact effectively with a wide range of people and personalities
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to work in an operating room setting
* Ability to accommodate a flexible work schedule
* Ortho, Spine or O.R. experience strongly preferred
* Preference will be given to local qualified candidates and candidates with Medtronic experience

**Additional Job Requirements:**
--------------------------------

* While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to be independently mobile
* Required to interact with a computer for extended periods of time, and communicate with peers and co\-workers
* Regularly required to talk or hear
* Occasionally required to sit and reach with hands and arms
* Regularly required to stand; walk and use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools , or controls
* Must frequently lift and/or move up to 50 pounds
* Specific vision abilities required by this job involve normal vision
* Ability to travel

\*\*Must have a valid driver's license and active vehicle insurance policy. In addition, your driving record will be reviewed and will be considered as part of your application.

jobs.title: Loro Piana, Seasonal Operations Specialist, Madison Avenue
jobs.description:
### **Position**

Loro Piana is an Italian luxury Maison founded in 1924, known for creating the finest quality textiles, ready\-to\-wear collections, accessories, and bespoke garments. Our dedication to exceptional craftsmanship and use of the world’s finest raw materials positions us a leader in the luxury industry. As an iconic Maison within the LVMH group, we uphold a strong commitment to unparalleled quality and excellence.  



General Purpose of the Position:


We are seeking a Seasonal Operations Specialist to join our team at Loro Piana. The Operations Specialist plays a pivotal role in the overall success of the business by supporting all operational and inventory\-related activities. You will be responsible for managing incoming and outgoing shipments, replenishing products on the sales floor, and organizing inventory to maximize efficiency. You will collaborate with all members of the team to ensure that stockroom conditions align with Loro Piana standards, contributing to seamless store operations.


### **Job responsibilities**

Key Responsibilities


* Optimize inventory flow and streamline operational processes while handling the accurate processing of shipments and transfers.
* Oversee the movement of merchandise from the stockroom to the sales floor and maintain appropriate inventory levels to align with sales potential.
* Conduct cycle counts as per corporate calendar to verify product quantities and report discrepancies in a timely manner. Perform regular audits to verify product conditions.
* Facilitate the implementation of security measures through inspections, audits, and preparing products for display.
* Ensure ongoing inventory organization according to company procedures and establish an optimized warehouse layout for improved accessibility by the sales team.
* Maintain clean, neat, and organized stock rooms with proper labeling to facilitate sales.
* Maintain effective communication with the operations team and external couriers to ensure accurate shipping procedures and timely delivery.
Provide the sales team with detailed updates regarding inventory availability to support the sales process and enhance sales performance.  
* 
### **Profile**

Skills and Abilities Required


* 3\+ years of operational and inventory experience, preferably in a luxury retail environment.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office, SAP, and other digital tools.
* Excellent communication, teamwork, and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong knowledge of operations and inventory control.
* Ability to lift and move objects up to 40 pounds.
### **Additional information**

What we offer


At Loro Piana, we believe in fostering a supportive and rewarding work environment that values our employees' well\-being and growth. We offer a comprehensive range of benefits including medical, dental, and vision coverage, fertility support, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, tuition reimbursement, 401K match, and Headspace mental health support. Additionally, employees enjoy a generous product discount, exclusive LVMH discounts, and other tailored perks.


Compensation


Loro Piana uses the published salary range as a guideline to provide our employees with market\-competitive pay while allowing for flexibility to recognize and reward various levels of expertise, performance, and tenure.
  

  

While the published salary range is a good faith reflection of the targeted salary level for the position, Loro Piana reserves the right to pay outside of the published salary range of $24 to $26 USD per hour.
  

  

EEO Statement


We strive to create a culture of inclusion where everyone has a sense of belonging. Our goal is to ensure that our outreach and recruiting efforts generate diverse identities and perspectives that will be valued and can thrive. We are continuously assessing our employee and candidate populations to identify ways to ensure they are all\-encompassing and equitable.


***LORO PIANA***
**MAISON**
---------------------------

Originally from Trivero in northern Italy, the Loro Piana family began trading wool in the early 1800s. In 1924, Pietro Loro Piana founded Ing. Loro Piana \& C., the current company. Pietro’s nephew Franco took over in 1941, and after the war the firm began to establish its reputation as a supplier of premium wool and cashmere textiles for a growing haute couture industry, both home and abroad. In the 1970s, Sergio and Pier Luigi Loro Piana took up the reins, diversifying into luxury goods and developing an international retail arm. Now the world’s foremost cashmere processor, Loro Piana prides itself on sourcing the very finest, rarest raw materials the world has to offer, including unique cashmere from baby goats in northern China and Mongolia, vicuña from the Andes, extra\-fine Merino wool from Australia and New Zealand and lotus flower fiber from Myanmar. The company draws on both time\-honored traditions and state of the art technology to offer its discerning customers products that are renowned for their peerless quality. All of the company’s collections of ready\-to\-wear garments and accessories are made in Italy to the highest standards of craftsmanship and sartorial excellence.

jobs.description:
**The Company:**


HallPass is building the next generation of candy. Our goal is simple: create the candy people already love, with a fraction of the calories, at the same price. HallPass recently launched nationwide at Walmart.


HallPass is part of the Medici Brands portfolio, alongside brands like David. This is a rare opportunity to join a breakout food brand at a pivotal stage of growth. Led by CEO Peter Rahal, Cofounder and Former CEO of RXBAR, and President Michael Tierney, Founder and Former CEO of Stuffed Puffs, HallPass brings together deep experience building and scaling category\-defining consumer brands.


HallPass is working to reimagine one of the largest and most iconic categories in food, proving that better nutrition doesn’t have to come at the expense of taste or price. With national distribution and ambitious plans to expand our product portfolio and retail presence, HallPass is working to become a leading candy brand in the U.S. and beyond.

**Role \& Responsibilities:**


This role owns how HallPass shows up every day in our organic channels, our creator partnerships, and the social\-first publishers that break snack news.


You’ll help define our voice on social, run our channels, own our influencer program end to end, and report on what’s working. It’s ideal for someone with strong brand instincts and native fluency in internet culture. * Brief content into the creative and external partners

jobs.title: Research Coordinator – Women’s Brain Health Research
jobs.description:
In this role, the successful candidate will independently coordinate and manage the day\-to\-day conduct of an NIH\-funded research study on **women’s brain health** (RF1AG098531\) conducted at the NYU Grossman School of Medicine. The Research Coordinator exercises independent judgment and discretion in managing study operations, resolving protocol and regulatory issues, determining participant eligibility, and analyzing study data — serving as the primary point of accountability for the study’s day\-to\-day scientific and operational integrity, under the general direction of the Principal Investigators.

  

  

  

### **Project**

  

  

This NIH\-funded project, led by Drs. Erika Raven and Jelle Veraart, focuses on improving women’s brain health by identifying why the menopause transition may increase the risk of cognitive decline and Alzheimer’s disease. Using longitudinal neuroimaging, plasma proteomics, and detailed clinical assessments of a prospective cohort, the study examines how hormonal changes and menopausal hormone therapy influence brain aging and cognitive outcomes. The goal is to define sex\-specific biomarkers and risk profiles that support earlier detection, more precise prevention, and clinically meaningful strategies to protect women’s health across midlife and aging.


### **Job Responsibilities**


**Study Coordination \& Regulatory Compliance**
* Independently manage the day\-to\-day operations of the study, exercising judgment to resolve protocol deviations, scheduling conflicts, and other non\-routine issues as they arise, escalating to the PIs only when appropriate
* Interpret and apply IRB and sponsor requirements; prepare, submit, and track continuing reviews, amendments, and reportable events, determining the appropriate course of action for ambiguous or non\-routine regulatory situations

**Participant Recruitment, Screening \& Eligibility Determination**
* Independently review medical records and screening data against complex study eligibility criteria; exercise judgment on borderline or ambiguous cases and make enrollment recommendations to the Principal Investigators
* Lead the informed consent process, ensuring participants understand study procedures, risks, and rights; manage enrollment, scheduling, and long\-term follow\-up of a prospective cohort

**Data Collection \& Quality Oversight**
* Coordinate and, where applicable, assist with MRI data collection, cognitive testing, and survey administration; select and adapt procedures to participant\-specific circumstances (e.g., menopause status, scheduling constraints) within study guidelines
* Oversee blood sample collection, storage, and shipping logistics for the plasma proteomics component of the study, ensuring compliance with protocol and chain\-of\-custody requirements

**Data Analysis, Reporting \& Team Liaison**
* Consolidate and analyze longitudinal clinical, imaging, and biomarker data; identify trends and data quality issues, and prepare summaries and recommendations that inform manuscript development and study reporting
* Serve as the primary liaison between the PIs, study team members, core facilities, and external collaborators, exercising discretion in coordinating cross\-functional study activities
### **Required Qualifications**


Bachelor’s degree in life sciences or a related discipline is required, along with a minimum of 2 years of clinical or human subjects research experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. Must demonstrate the ability to exercise independent judgment and discretion in coordinating study operations, resolving non\-routine issues, and interfacing with participants, investigators, and regulatory bodies with minimal supervision. Effective oral and written communication and interpersonal skills, along with strong time management, organizational, and analytical skills, are required.
### **Preferred Qualifications**


Knowledge of basic medical terminology is preferred. Prior experience independently coordinating research protocols, and working with EPIC and REDCap, is preferred. Experience working in an academic medical center environment, and prior experience training or guiding junior research staff, is also preferred.


### **About Us**


NYU Grossman School of Medicine provides its staff with far more than just a place to work. Rather, we are an institution you can be proud of, an institution where you’ll feel good about devoting your time and your talents. At NYU Langone Health, we are committed to supporting our workforce and their loved ones with a comprehensive benefits and wellness package. Our offerings provide a robust support system for any stage of life, whether it’s developing your career, starting a family, or saving for retirement. The support employees receive goes beyond a standard benefit offering, where employees have access to financial security benefits, a generous time\-off program and employee resources groups for peer support. Additionally, all employees have access to our holistic employee wellness program, which focuses on seven key areas of well\-being: physical, mental, nutritional, sleep, social, financial, and preventive care. The benefits and wellness package is designed to allow you to focus on what truly matters. Join us and experience the extensive resources and services designed to enhance your overall quality of life for you and your family.


NYU Grossman School of Medicine is an equal opportunity employer and committed to inclusion in all aspects of recruiting and employment. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply and will receive consideration. We require applications to be completed online.

jobs.description:
The Executive Assistant will support the CEO of Bessemer Trust, a family office overseeing more than $250 billion in assets for over 3,000 individuals and families of substantial wealth. The Executive Assistant will provide seamless administrative support and serve as a liaison with key internal and external partners, requiring a clear understanding of the firm's priorities and the ability to build effective working relationships across departments and seniority levels.


Success in this role demands unquestionable integrity, sound judgment in handling sensitive and confidential matters, and exceptional interpersonal and organizational skills. The ideal candidate brings excellent attention to detail, the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast\-paced environment, and a collaborative, solutions\-oriented approach to their work.


**Primary Responsibilities:**

**Executive Support**


* Manage the CEO's time effectively, balancing immediate demands with longer\-term priorities and exercising sound judgment in evaluating and prioritizing requests.
* Manage a complex and dynamic calendar, proactively identifying conflicts, anticipating scheduling needs, and ensuring the CEO's time is aligned with business priorities.
* Serve as a key point of contact for internal and external stakeholders, facilitating effective communication and appropriate access to the CEO.

Eligible employees may participate in a 401(k) program with a generous profit\-sharing contribution, medical, prescription dental, and vision coverage; life insurance; disability coverage; paid holidays; vacation; and sick time, subject to plan terms and Company policies.

* Process and prepare Sales Orders, RMAs, certificates, and related documentation.

* Handle incoming calls, emails, correspondence, and general office administration.
* Maintain office and facility supplies and ensure work areas remain organized.
* Provide administrative and operational support to the President and team.

**Qualifications**

Required:

* 2\+ years of experience in administrative operations, order\-processing, warehouse\-support, or similar role.

* Ability to manage multiple priorities and switch between administrative and hands\-on operational tasks.

* Experience working in a manufacturing, electronics, technology, or distribution environment.

* Familiarity with UPS, FedEx, or other shipping systems.
* Experience supporting a small business or executive/President.
* Experience with accounting software a plus, but not mandatory.

The successful candidate will be someone who:

* Pays attention to the details and catches errors before they become problems.
* Is highly organized and keeps both paperwork and physical work areas orderly.

jobs.title: DERMS Operations Specialist - DERMS / DER Operations
jobs.description:
The DERMS Operations Specialist plays a crucial role in the development and implementation of the Distributed Energy Resource Management System (DERMS). This newly created position offers a unique opportunity to be at the forefront of innovation, laying the groundwork for the expansion of energy management within the distribution system. The DERMS Operations Specialist is responsible for the real\-time and near\-real\-time operational integration of Distributed Energy Resources (DERs) on the electric distribution system. This role ensures DERs are operated safely, reliably, and in compliance with grid constraints, using DERMS and related advanced distribution applications. The specialist serves as a technical bridge between distribution system operators, planning, IT/OT systems, and DER programs.


Currently, DERMS is in Phase I of implementation, focusing on visibility of the distribution system. During this stage, the DERMS Operations Specialist will maintain system awareness, monitor distributed resources, and evaluate load and generation forecasts. As the program prepares for Phase II, which includes system optimization and dispatch, the DERMS Operations Specialist will contribute to the development of user interfaces, tools, and processes necessary for seamless and reliable DERMS operations. As new distributed resources are integrated, the specialist will ensure communication paths are established for real\-time monitoring and dispatch.


This role will initially follow a hybrid work schedule, with four days per week, Monday through Thursday, at the office located at 241 Ralph McGill.

Parenting is demanding, and that’s where we come in. We want to reimagine how brands can make it easier for early stage parents – not by just selling them products, but by providing holistic solutions that transcend borders, categories and aisles.


No matter our title or department, at Kids2, our job is to create more tiny wins for parents, so they can create bright futures for their little ones. That’s a big task!


We’re serious about what we do, AND we love to have fun. Our team is hardworking, entrepreneurial, and passionate about helping families create millions, if not billions of tiny wins.

**SUMMARY**


The Integrated Marketing Manager is accountable for GTM planning and execution across assigned product launches within Kids2’s portfolio of brands. This role translates product, brand, customer, and market priorities into integrated launch plans that support consumer relevance, retail readiness, and commercial impact. The Manager leads day\-to\-day coordination of communication briefs, content creation, packaging, activations, and launch deliverables across retail and digital touchpoints.


This role partners cross\-functionally with stakeholders across Category, Insights, Performance Marketing, Sales, Creative, Social, Ecommerce, and Legal to ensure launch plans are aligned, executed on time, and positioned to support a cohesive consumer experience and business objectives.

**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES AND ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**

**GTM Planning and Execution**

* Accountable for GTM planning and execution for assigned product launches across Kids2’s portfolio of brands.
* Translate business priorities, product strategy, customer needs, and consumer insights into integrated launch plans.
* Manage day\-to\-day launch coordination, workback plans, timelines, milestones, and deliverables.
* Ensure launch readiness across communication briefs, content, packaging, activations, and digital touchpoints.

**Product Marketing**

* Create and manage cross\-functional product marketing strategies and execution for assigned products across retail and digital touchpoints.
* Ensure key milestones are achieved within the end\-to\-end process leading up to launch, including communication briefs, creative reviews, content creation, and digital shelf readiness.
* Support packaging and ecommerce readiness to ensure consumer\-facing materials are aligned and on time.

**Brand Marketing**

* Assist in developing go\-to\-market strategy, including consumer\-facing marketing assets and campaigns, to effectively launch products to a global audience.
* Collaborate with internal Creative, Social, and Performance Marketing teams to develop advertising, social/community, influencer, PR, and retail experiences.
* Help ensure that the total consumer experience is cohesive across channels and touchpoints.

**Customer Marketing**

* Work with key accounts such as Amazon, Target, Walmart, and Babylist, along with global and regional Sales teams, to understand customer marketing needs.
* Support product launches through customer\-specific activations and paid marketing campaigns.
* Partner with sales planning and cross\-functional teams to help ensure customer requirements are incorporated into launch plans.

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with internal stakeholders to drive alignment and execution across launch workstreams.
* Maintain clear communication, organization, and follow\-through across teams.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Marketing Analysis**

* Track and report launch performance against agreed\-upon success metrics
* Support post\-launch recaps by gathering inputs, results, and learnings
* Identify executional learnings that can inform future campaign planning

**Competitive Intelligence**

* Monitor competitive product launch strategies and tactics to ensure Kids2’s go\-to\-market plans remain strong and competitive.
* Prepare and share competitive updates to increase organizational visibility and awareness

**QUALIFICATIONS \& EXPERIENCE**

* 3–5 years of related experience in marketing, product marketing, integrated marketing, or go\-to\-market execution

**EDUCATION \& SKILLS**

* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field required, or equivalent experience
* Product launch experience
* Experience supporting national or global integrated marketing plans for recognized B2C brands
* Working knowledge of digital marketing, including ecommerce, media, social, paid search, attribution, and optimization
* Consumer insights experience to help improve campaign targeting, delivery, or performance
* Strong presentation skills for senior management and retailer presentations
* Strong organizational, analytical, and writing skills
* Ability to work in a matrixed environment and manage multiple priorities

**CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS**

* None

**COMPUTER/TECHNICAL SKILLS**

* Must be proficient in PowerPoint, Excel, and Word

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS**

* While performing the duties of this job, the team member is regularly required to talk or hear.
* The team member frequently is required to sit; have flexible use of hands; reach with hands and arms; and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl.
* The team member is occasionally required to stand, walk, and taste or smell.
* The team member must regularly lift and/or move up to 10 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 \- 50 pounds.
* Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT**

* General office environment

**Job Title**


Marketing Manager, Multifamily Digital Marketing
(https://careers.cushmanwakefield.com/)**Job Description Summary**


The Marketing Manager, Multifamily Digital Marketing is responsible for developing and executing digital marketing strategies that drive qualified lead generation, optimize the online customer journey, and support portfolio performance across a national multifamily portfolio. This role serves as the bridge between property operations, digital marketing vendors, and corporate marketing teams to ensure communities maximize digital visibility, conversion performance, and brand consistency.  

  

The ideal candidate brings a strong background in multifamily digital marketing, website management, local search optimization, marketing technology, and data\-driven decision making. They are comfortable managing multiple initiatives simultaneously, leveraging emerging technologies and AI tools, and providing strategic guidance to onsite teams and marketing stakeholders.**Job Description**

**Responsibilities:**

Digital Strategy \& Performance Marketing

* Develop and execute portfolio\-level digital marketing strategies focused on lead generation, conversion optimization, and occupancy goals.
* Analyze performance data across websites, paid media, CRM systems, and reputation platforms to identify trends and recommend optimization opportunities.
* Partner with internal teams and external vendors to improve website performance, SEO, SEM, paid media, and digital customer experience initiatives.
* Monitor marketing KPIs and provide actionable recommendations that improve traffic, lead quality, conversion rates, and customer engagement.
* Support portfolio marketing planning through data analysis, reporting, and performance benchmarking.


Website \& Digital Experience Management

* Own website content strategy, ongoing optimization efforts, and quality assurance across assigned communities.
* Manage website launches, redesigns, branding updates, and digital asset implementation.
* Partner with website vendors and internal stakeholders to troubleshoot issues, implement enhancements, and improve user experience.
* Ensure community websites maintain accurate content, pricing, imagery, and digital compliance standards.


Search, Reputation \& Local Marketing

* Develop strategies to improve local search visibility through Google Business Profile optimization, directory management, and reputation initiatives.
* Monitor online reputation performance and identify opportunities to improve ratings, reviews, and resident engagement.
* Recommend and implement best practices that increase visibility and strengthen brand presence across digital channels.


Marketing Technology \& Innovation

* Serve as a subject matter expert on multifamily marketing technology platforms including Yardi, RentCafe, Knock CRM, Engrain, Google Business Profile, and related tools.
* Evaluate emerging technologies, AI solutions, and automation opportunities that improve operational efficiency and marketing effectiveness.
* Support implementation and adoption of new marketing technologies across the portfolio.
* Identify opportunities to streamline workflows through automation and digital process improvements.


Leadership \& Team Development

* Provide mentorship and strategic guidance to marketing specialists and onsite teams.
* Lead training initiatives focused on digital marketing best practices, website management, reputation management, and emerging technology.
* Partner with leadership teams to support national marketing initiatives and operational priorities.
* Assist with onboarding, coaching, and professional development efforts within the marketing organization.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or related field.
* 5\+ years of experience in digital marketing, multifamily marketing, performance marketing, or related field.
* Demonstrated experience with website management, SEO, SEM, Google Business Profiles, reputation management, and digital analytics.
* Experience working with multifamily technology platforms including Yardi, RentCafe, Knock CRM, Entrata, Engrain, or comparable systems.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate marketing performance data into actionable business recommendations.
* Experience managing external marketing vendors and agency relationships.
* Knowledge of AI\-powered marketing tools, automation platforms, and emerging digital marketing technologies.
* Previous leadership, mentorship, or team development experience preferred.
* Strong project management and stakeholder management skills.

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description:
**Company Overview:**


**About Us:**  

Atlanta\-based Incident IQ is the leading workflow management platform built exclusively for K\-12 districts. Trusted by over 2,000 districts, Incident IQ powers mission\-critical services for more than 12 million students and educators nationwide. By connecting technology and operational workflows, Incident IQ enables schools to streamline processes, reduce administrative burdens, and focus on what matters most: supporting students.


**Purpose:**  

Incident IQ is committed to creating a future where every K\-12 district operates with seamless efficiency. When operations are unified on a single platform, districts gain the clarity and control needed to build a stronger foundation for student success. We're focused on delivering the tools, support, and partnerships that help make that vision a reality.


**Mission:**  

Incident IQ is on a mission to eliminate the friction of disconnected systems and clunky workflows that slow schools down. We're reimagining the critical work that happens behind the scenes, bringing visibility, efficiency, and impact to the processes that keep classrooms running. By streamlining the complex, automating the routine, and surfacing the insights that matter most, we can create the conditions for educators to teach, students to thrive, and districts to shape the future of education.

**Sales Development Representative Overview:**

  



Reporting directly to the Revenue Operations Leader, the Sales Development Representative SDR) will be responsible for generating interest and qualifying leads with target school districts within assigned territories.

  



The SDR will work actively with our field sales team to identify target school districts and implement outreach cadences to generate and qualify leads for our products. The GDR will also work extensively within our marketing automation and AI\-powered tools to identify, develop, and qualify leads for our field sales team. This role also manages and maintains our lead process protocols to ensure all qualified sales leads are properly distributed and tracked in our sales support systems.

  



Our Sales Development Team thrives on culture and collaboration, so working together 2\-3 days a week in one of our two offices \- Alpharetta and Atlanta \- is required.

  


**Sales Development Representative Responsibilities:**


* Generate new business pipeline primarily through outbound prospecting
* Operate within RevOps at the intersection of Sales and Marketing, working inside a centrally coordinated outreach cadence that sequences prospect touches across Demand Gen, SDR, and Sales to prevent duplicate or conflicting outreach
* Design effective outbound prospecting sequences to effectively contact target school districts
* Engage and qualify prospects using agentic\-powered workflows, insights, and automated intelligence
* Utilize AI agents to research accounts, tailor messaging, and execute high\-quality outreach at scale, alongside core sales tech stack
* Activate demand by delivering personalized engagement across email, phone, social, and in\-product channels
* Partner with Demand Generation to act on campaign and account signals in real time, prioritizing outreach based on the most current marketing and sales intelligence available
* Carry and consistently deliver against a quota and activity metrics, tracked through Salesforce/Gong, and reported in a weekly goal\-setting and readout cadence
* Represent Incident IQ at industry conferences, trade shows, and marketing\-hosted events, including independently engaging prospects and conducting account drop\-ins as needed
* Work strategically with your field sales partner on a Go\-to\-Market strategy

  


**Sales Development Representative Requirements:**


* Four (4\) year college degree, or equivalent
* Experience or interest in working with AI\-powered sales engagement tools to improve prospecting efficiency and outreach quality
* Sales tech experience \- Primarily Salesforce, Gong, and Qualified to maximize performance and efficiency
* High energy, high activity personality and personal drive

 **What makes Incident IQ different:**


* We facilitate whole\-person growth where employees can develop personally as well as professionally.
* We offer an energetic and collaborative environment; everyone's opinion matters!
* We produce software that empowers K\-12 schools to run efficiently, allowing for a better classroom experience for students to THRIVE!
* We provide excellent work/life balance. Two amazing offices \- a Downtown Atlanta office location and one at Halcyon in Alpharetta!

  



Incident IQ offers a competitive salary based on experience with a benefits package for full\-time employees that includes medical, dental, vision, life insurance, 401k match, and paid\-time off (PTO).

  




*Incident IQ is an Equal Opportunity Employer*

We are looking for someone with a proven track record and hunger for success in our industry. Your pivotal role involves creating a well\-structured sales funnel through proactive prospecting, ensuring a steady flow of activity and opportunities for our sales team.

* Clear and concise written and verbal communication
* Results driven and motivated for sales
* Excellent customer service

* Previous sales experience a plus

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
Overview:

This is PowerPlan's first Business Development Representative role — a high\-visibility seat built to solve one of the company's most pressing go\-to\-market challenges: building predictable top\-of\-funnel pipeline in a new\-market sales motion. You'll be the engine behind outbound prospecting into asset\-intensive enterprises, opening conversations with senior finance and IT leaders, qualifying opportunities, and booking discovery calls that free our Strategic Account Executives to focus on closing.  

This role comes with a defined career progression path mapped out at approximately the 18\-month mark, a full sales tech stack on day one, and finalized ICP and buyer personas before you start. It's the right seat for someone early in their sales career who wants to learn enterprise software sales from the inside, build a foundation in a complex B2B market, and grow into a closing role.
Responsibilities:

Success will be measured by how fast you ramp to full outbound activity, how consistently you hit your outreach targets, and by the quality — not just the volume — of the meetings you hand off to Strategic AEs.* Complete structured onboarding and earn messaging certification within your first 60 days, ramping to full outbound activity targets.
* Execute a high\-volume, multi\-channel outbound motion — cold calling, cold email, and LinkedIn\-led social selling — targeting buying committees within PowerPlan's ideal customer profile.
* Hit weekly and monthly activity targets for outbound calls, emails, and meaningful conversations, and log every interaction in Salesforce same\-day.
* Qualify every inbound and outbound lead against BANT criteria and PowerPlan's ICP before booking a discovery call.
* Hand off qualified meetings to Strategic AEs with clean, complete context — account background, contact details, the pain or trigger behind the conversation, and relevant CRM history.
* Report back to Marketing Ops on lead source strength, messaging effectiveness, and objection patterns, and partner with Strategic AEs on coordinated outbound into named accounts.
* Support pre\- and post\-conference meeting generation, webinar attendance campaigns, and post\-webinar follow\-up sequences.


Qualifications:
* 1\-2 years in a sales, business development, or customer\-facing role (strong candidates with 0\-1 years will be considered).
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field.
* Exceptional verbal and written communication — able to hold a credible business conversation with a senior finance or IT leader.
* Builds rapport quickly and articulates a value proposition clearly and concisely, without over\-relying on scripts.
* Working proficiency with Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, sales intelligence tools (Ample Market or equivalent), and spreadsheets.
* Resilient and goal\-oriented — high tolerance for rejection and the ability to stay consistent in high\-volume outreach over time.
* Curious and coachable — acts on feedback fast and applies lessons from every conversation to the next one.
* Disciplined about CRM hygiene and activity logging — you treat Salesforce as a tool that makes you better, not a reporting burden.
* Competitive drive with a team orientation — you want to win, and you want the AEs you support to win too.

**Preferred**

* Interest in enterprise software, finance, or the energy and utilities sector.

**What We Provide**

* A full sales tech stack on day one: Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Ample Market, and sales engagement tooling.
* Finalized ICP and buyer personas before your first day — no guessing who to call.
* Flexible call and email templates with room to personalize.
* A structured onboarding and messaging certification program.
* An MBO\-based plan combined with metrics\-based compensation.
* A defined career progression path to a closing role at approximately the 18\-month mark.
* Health coverage, 401(k), PTO, and hybrid flexibility.

**PowerPlan is an EOE**
Applicant Privacy Notice  

Please note that this is a hybrid role that involves a combination of onsite work from our corporate office as well as work from home. While we strive to accommodate flexible working arrangements when sensible, there will be times when onsite work is required. This could include scheduled office days, team meetings, client meetings, or special events.

360 Network Solutions (360NS) is a growing technology solutions and systems integration company helping transportation and public\-sector agencies deploy, operate, and support the technologies that keep critical roadway infrastructure connected and performing. We are seeking a responsive, organized, and relationship\-focused professional to join our team as a Client Relations Specialist. This is a full\-time, on\-site position based at our Marietta headquarters, reporting to our Director of Operations and working closely with Sales, Operations, Finance, technical personnel, manufacturers, vendors, and company leadership.


The Client Relations Specialist serves as a primary connection between 360NS, its customers, and its sales opportunities. The position combines customer service, client relationship management, sales support, quote management, and business development.


A major responsibility of this role is ensuring customer requests—particularly quotes, pricing, product information, and project assistance—are acknowledged, handled promptly, and followed through to completion.
