jobs.title: MSFT AI Business Solutions Project Coordinator Intern
jobs.description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**


At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well\-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80\-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI\-enabled insights and technology\-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe**  

Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.


As you grow, you’ll also begin to take ownership of client relationships, contribute to account strategy, and support the delivery of high\-impact work. Developing a sense of account leadership, including understanding client needs, ensuring delivery excellence, and building trusted partnerships, is part of what sets successful consultants apart.


Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.


As a **MSFT AI Business Solutions** **Project Coordinator professional** in **Crowe’s Consulting Practice**, your role will be focused on helping clients resolve business needs by assisting in managing the project scope with customers, providing project leadership updates on progress, aligning direction of Crowe and customer team members with tasks for implementing complex business and technology solutions. At Crowe, we empower you to take risks, to challenge yourself in specialized areas of consulting \& technology, and to generate solutions that impact the firm and your professional growth. Crowe cultivates a creative company culture where you will have the opportunity to share your ideas and knowledge with clients from your very first day with the firm. The Project Coordinator is the central hub to manage all aspects of delivery to our clients. This is a lead\-in role for those individuals growing into a project manager career path.


You will work with clients in the manufacturing and distribution industry to help transform their business requirements into a state\-of\-the\-art cloud solution that will enable their organization to exploit new opportunities, engage better with their customers and compete globally in the dynamic “Cloud\-First” era. New hires will assist in project management activities to enable successful project outcomes by facilitating client communication, gathering business requirements, maintaining project scope, and removing project barriers. You will be expected to lead team\-building events and develop internal team and customer relationships.


**Skills and Requirements:**

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot issues, identify root causes, and deliver effective solutions
* Clear and confident communication skills, with the ability to simplify and explain complex concepts to diverse stakeholders
* Collaborative mindset with strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work effectively across teams, functions, and geographies
* Adaptable and flexible, with the ability to manage shifting priorities in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment
* Eagerness to learn new technologies and a commitment to continuous skill development
* Willingness to travel as needed 60% or more annually based on client or project requirements

**Education:**


We’re looking for college seniors or graduate students graduating within the next year who are pursuing degrees in **Business, Management, or a related field**, and are eager to launch a career in a fast\-paced, client\-focused environment. Preferred areas of study include:

* Business Administration
* Accounting
* Finance
* Operations Management
* Supply Chain
* Management
* Information Technology or Information Systems
* Or a comparable major


We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.


In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire. Crowe is not sponsoring for work authorization at this time.


The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Crowe, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $27\.00 \- $42\.00 per hour. **Our Benefits:**  

Your exceptional people experien

jobs.title: Project Coordinator - Asset Recovery - CHI
jobs.description:
**PROJECT COORDINATOR – ASSET RECOVERY**

**Employment Type: Full\-Time****Work Arrangement: Hybrid – Office / Remote****Reports To: Asset Recovery Leadership****Position Summary**


The Project Coordinator – Asset Recovery is responsible for supporting the planning, coordination, execution, and documentation of asset recovery and IT Asset Disposition (ITAD) projects.


This position serves as a central point of coordination between customers, operations, transportation providers, warehouse teams, project managers, sales, and other internal resources to ensure projects are executed accurately, securely, on schedule, and in accordance with established customer requirements.


The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail\-oriented, comfortable managing multiple projects simultaneously, and able to communicate effectively in a fast\-paced logistics environment. Because Asset Recovery projects frequently involve sensitive technology assets, customer data, serial\-number tracking, chain\-of\-custody requirements, and multiple service partners, attention to detail and documentation are critical to success.


This is a hybrid position requiring regular presence in the office, combined with the flexibility to work remotely based on business needs and the established hybrid schedule.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Project Coordination**

* Coordinate Asset Recovery projects from initial project setup through final completion and closeout.
* Review project scope, customer requirements, schedules, locations, equipment quantities, transportation requirements, and special handling instructions.
* Create and maintain project schedules, task lists, project documentation, and internal communication.
* Coordinate project activities with internal operations teams, transportation providers, warehouses, field crews, technicians, recycling partners, and other service providers.
* Confirm resources, equipment, transportation, labor, and site requirements prior to scheduled project activity.
* Track project milestones and proactively identify scheduling conflicts, missing information, or potential service issues.
* Communicate project changes and requirements to all appropriate stakeholders.**Customer Communication**
* Serve as a day\-to\-day coordination contact for assigned customers and projects.
* Provide professional and timely communication regarding project schedules, status, documentation, exceptions, and completion.
* Coordinate site contacts, access requirements, dock schedules, security requirements, certificates of insurance, and other customer\-specific requirements.
* Assist Project Managers and Asset Recovery leadership with customer meetings, project updates, and reporting.
* Maintain a strong customer\-service mindset and help ensure that commitments made to customers are successfully executed.**Asset Tracking \& Chain of Custody**
* Support accurate tracking of technology assets throughout the recovery and disposition process.
* Ensure required documentation is collected and maintained throughout each project.
* Assist with tracking serial numbers, asset tags, quantities, pallet counts, shipment information, and final disposition records.
* Maintain accurate chain\-of\-custody documentation from customer location through transportation, processing, disposition, recycling, resale, or other approved destination.
* Identify discrepancies between expected and actual asset quantities and escalate exceptions promptly.
* Support reconciliation of project records and final asset reporting.**Logistics \& Transportation Coordination**
* Schedule and coordinate transportation required for Asset Recovery projects.
* Confirm vehicle requirements, pickup and delivery appointments, site restrictions, loading requirements, and special handling needs.
* Communicate shipment requirements to transportation partners and field operations.
* Track shipments and project activity through completion.
* Assist with resolving delays, missed appointments, damaged assets, documentation discrepancies, or other transportation exceptions.
* Coordinate multiple locations and shipments when projects involve regional or national deployments.**Documentation \& Compliance**
* Maintain complete and accurate electronic project files.
* Ensure required documentation is received, including bills of lading, chain\-of\-custody records, asset inventories, photographs, manifests, certificates, and other project\-specific documentation.
* Follow established Asset Recovery procedures related to information security, data\-bearing equipment, customer confidentiality, and asset handling.
* Support compliance with customer\-specific requirements and applicable company policies and procedures.
* Assist with preparation of project closeout documentation and customer reporting.
* Maintain confidentiality regarding customer information, technology assets, and sensitive project information.**Financial \& Administrative Support**
* Assist with reviewing project costs and supporting documentation.
* Collect and organize vendor invoices, transportation charges, labor documentation, and other project expenses.
* Assist Project Managers with comparing estimated project costs to actual project costs.
* Identify unexpected charges or scope changes for review.
* Support accurate and timely project billing by ensuring required documentation is complete.
* Assist with purchase orders, work orders, vendor documentation, and other administrative project requirements.**Cross\-Functional Coordination**
* Work closely with Asset Recovery leadership, Project Managers, Sales, Operations, Transportation Management, Sourcing, Accounting, IT, and other internal departments.
* Participate in project kickoff meetings and operational planning calls.
* Escalate potential customer, operational, financial, security, or scheduling issues before they impact project performance.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives designed to improve Asset Recovery processes, docum

jobs.title: Mentoring Program Coordinator - Leaders of Tomorrow
jobs.description:
**Overview**

Join our dynamic team as a Mentoring Program Coordinator for the Leaders of Tomorrow initiative! In this role, you will be at the forefront of empowering youth and fostering community engagement through innovative mentoring programs. Your energy, leadership, and organizational skills will drive the success by creating meaningful connections that inspire growth and development. This position offers an exciting opportunity to make a tangible impact while honing your project management and community engagement expertise.

This role is ideal for motivated individuals passionate about leadership development and community service. If you thrive in fast paced environments where your proactive approach can foster meaningful change apply today to become a vital part of our mission to empower tomorrow’s leaders!

**POSITION SUMMARY** 

Under the supervision of the Director of Youth Services, the **Leaders of Tomorrow School\-Based Group Mentoring Program Coordinator** will oversee all programmatic and administrative aspects of group mentoring services at Shields Middle School. The LOT Mentoring Program Coordinator is responsible for working collaboratively with school staff to recruit prospective youth participants, coordinate scheduling of group sessions, oversee the implementation of the group curriculum, supervise the LOT Mentor to ensure high quality service delivery, and provide direct group mentoring services to youth participants. The Program Coordinator should be passionate about supporting youth development and working collaboratively with students, families, and school staff to help middle school youth attain holistic well\-being.

This is a year\-round position and requires a flexible work schedule that accommodates students and their families.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Oversee recruitment of eligible group mentoring participants
* Work with school staff to schedule group mentoring sessions without disrupting instruction
* Develop and implement individualized strategies to sustain consistent youth engagement in group mentoring services over time, in collaboration with school staff, the LOT Mentor, and parents or guardians as appropriate
* Oversee the implementation of BPNC’s evidence\-informed group mentoring curriculum
* Provide ongoing individual supervision to the LOT Mentor based at Chicago Public School located on the southwest side of Chicago, in order to ensure high quality service delivery
* Deliver group mentoring services to youth participants
* Participate in continuous improvement sessions with the City of Chicago Department of Family and Support Services to review data, monitor progress, and assess youth outcomes
* In consultation with the LOT mentor and mentees, plan and facilitate quarterly, youth\-led outings that are developmentally appropriate and focus on areas of support identified by the youth themselves
* Collaborate with external partners to connect youth to additional services and resources as needed
* Maintain a positive work atmosphere by behaving and communicating in an appropriate and respectful manner with supervisees, students, school, agency staff, and parents
* Participate in regular staff meetings, staff trainings, supervisory sessions and other duties as assigned by the supervisor
* Adhere to agency policy, procedures and the professional code of ethics
* Perform other related duties as assigned

**POSITION REQUIREMENTS**

* Bachelor's degree required
* At least 1 year of supervisory experience preferred
* At least 2 years of experience providing mentoring support to school age children and adolescents
* Must be over 24 years old
* Required bilingual in Spanish
* Sensitive to needs of low\-income/immigrant youth and their families
* Must be highly organized, self\-motivated and comfortable working independently
* Ability to travel between different work sites
* Ability to pass a routine background check as well as a Chicago Public Schools background check

Pay: $60,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* Are you over 24 years old?

Education:

* Bachelor's (Required)

Experience:

* Supervising: 1 year (Required)
* Mentoring: 2 years (Preferred)

Language:

* English and Spanish (Required)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: CPG Brand Coordinator
jobs.description:
This is a cross\-functional brand operations role designed to support all areas of the CPG business. The Brand Coordinator acts as the central connector across marketing, product development, ecommerce, sales support, and operations to keep launches, campaigns, and day\-to\-day execution moving.


This is a utility player who can project manage, organize, and execute across multiple workstreams. The role is highly detail oriented, and execution focused, ensuring deadlines are met, assets are organized, and teams have what they need to deliver against brand and revenue goals.

**Core Responsibilities**

**Cross Functional Project Management**

* Support all product launches across Nutrire and Tricoci brands from concept through go live
* Maintain master launch calendars and ensure deadlines are met across teams
* Track deliverables across marketing, product development, ecommerce, and supply chain
* Run weekly status updates and follow ups to keep projects on track
* Support retailer launch readiness including item setup coordination and asset delivery

**Marketing and Brand Support**

* Coordinate campaign timelines, asset requests, and approvals
* Manage sample trafficking for PR, influencers, shoots, and retailers
* Support photoshoots, content production, and campaign logistics
* Organize brand asset libraries and ensure teams have correct files
* Assist with event execution, field education support, and brand activations

**Ecommerce and Sales Support**

* Assist Ecommerce Operations Manager with PDP updates, asset uploads, and product setup
* Support promotional calendar execution and bundle setup
* Help coordinate retailer requests for content, copy, and imagery
* Track ratings and reviews requests and sampling programs
* Support marketplace and retailer launch checklists

**Product Development and Operations Support**

* Support PD team with sample tracking, shade or formula tracking, and documentation
* Coordinate packaging proof approvals and artwork routing
* Maintain SKU master data and product information sheets
* Help track inventory needs for marketing, PR, and retailer requests
* Assist with competitive research and product audits

**Administrative and Organizational Support**

* Maintain shared documents, trackers, and calendars
* Prepare decks, recaps, and internal updates
* Support meeting coordination and follow ups
* Ensure teams are aligned on timelines and next steps

**Qualifications**

* 2 to 4 years’ experience in CPG, beauty, or brand operations
* Highly organized with strong attention to detail
* Strong project management and follow through
* Comfortable juggling multiple priorities and deadlines
* Strong communication and coordination skills
* Proficient in Microsoft Suite, Google Suite, Canva, and project management tools

**Preferred Experience**

* Beauty or prestige brand experience
* Experience supporting product launches or campaigns
* Familiarity with ecommerce platforms and retailer portals
* Experience coordinating photoshoots, sampling, or events

**Success Metrics**

* On time launch execution
* Organized and accurate trackers and documentation

Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. ***Ideal role for someone looking to kick\-start their career in sales with structured training and coaching. 1\+ years of sales experience is preferred but not required.*** 

*The Experience:*

We're hiring someone to build a rewarding sales career with the training, coaching, and uncapped earning potential to back it up.

As a Sales Representative, you'll lead the entire customer journey. This is a full\-cycle role: you’ll manage inbound leads, diagnose exterior damage, educate homeowners, and guide them through everything from proposal to signed contract. Every deal you close is a deal you own and every referral and repeat customer you earn compounds into a book of business that's genuinely yours.

You'll work alongside Sales Management and Production, and you'll be backed by a company that is serious about investing in its people and committed to their long\-term success.

This is a field role. You'll spend your time inspecting roofs and siding, and meeting homeowners where they are (within Chicagoland area \- not storm chasing). You'll also spend regular time in the office for coaching, training, and team meetings.

*Training \& Career Growth:*

From day one, you're invested in through a structured development path designed to turn new reps into top performers.

* Initial onboarding: a structured start that gets you up to speed on our process, systems, and expectations before you're on your own
* Product training: deep, hands\-on knowledge of roofing, siding, windows, and gutters so you can speak to homeowners with real credibility
* Sales training: proven frameworks for objection handling, estimating, and closing, taught by people who've done the job
* Ride\-alongs: shadow experienced reps and get shadowed yourself, so feedback is built into the job

* Running company\-provided appointments sourced through marketing efforts
* Performing roof, siding, window, and gutter inspections to accurately assess damage and scope of work
* Educating homeowners on products, solutions, and the insurance claims process where applicable
* Preparing estimates and proposals, then negotiating and closing sales
* Following up with prospects to keep your pipeline moving
* Managing projects from signed contract through completion, delivering an exceptional customer experience at every step
* Building a base of referral and repeat business over time

* You're comfortable initiating conversations and building trust with homeowners
* You have a strong work ethic and are self\-motivated
* You're coachable, curious, and eager to learn
* You thrive in a performance\-based environment
* You have strong organizational and time\-management skills
* You hold a valid driver's license and have reliable transportation

*Even Better If...*

* You have outside sales or in\-home sales experience

This role is based out of our office located in Schaumburg, Illinois, serving the surrounding Chicago northwest suburbs. **Marketing Development Representatives (MDRs) are crucial team members who identify and connect with** **inbound****prospective customers** **on the impact ServiceTitan can bring to their business. A successful MDR drives the initial sales process by qualifying leads, conducting detailed discovery, and setting up the Account Executive for success.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Why You'll Love This Role:**

* Career Foundation: You will be given extensive coaching and development from managers, enablement coaches, and various teams to ensure you are set up for a successful, long\-term career in Sales.
* Culture of Excellence: Join a team motivated to be the best every day by continuously applying feedback and best practices.
* Direct Impact: You lead the charge in transforming an industry and shaping your future career by being the initial voice of ServiceTitan.

**What You'll Do (Responsibilities):**
--------------------------------------


Your primary focus is building a robust sales pipeline and converting marketing\-generated opportunities into qualified meetings.

* Pipeline Generation: Build a strong pipeline of prospective customers by sourcing potential leads and converting inbound opportunities efficiently.
* Strategic Engagement: Implement creative ways to engage and build rapport to maintain and progress your book of prospects.
* Meeting Conversion: Successfully book product demonstrations between ServiceTitan and potential customers by collaborating with Account Executives to secure the partnership.
* Value Communication: Clearly articulate the product's value and areas of opportunity to prospects via phone and/or e\-mail.
* Goal Achievement: Achieve and exceed daily KPIs and monthly quota for qualified meetings and pipeline generation.

**What You'll Bring (Qualifications):**
---------------------------------------


We are looking for ambitious, adaptable team players ready to take the first critical step in a professional sales career.

* Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills to effectively manage a high volume of daily phone and e\-mail contacts.
* Ambition: You recognize every day is a new opportunity for you to be better than yesterday, demonstrating genuine self\-motivation.
* Coachability: An intense appetite to seek and, most importantly, adapt feedback that is given to drive continuous improvement.
* Teamwork: A strong team player mentality demonstrated by effectively collaborating and being a positive influence on colleagues.
* Adaptability: The ability to be adaptable and think outside the box to proactively address potential roadblocks and/or issues.

**Our Investment in Your Success:**
-----------------------------------


We invest heavily in our people to ensure you are set up for a successful, long\-term sales career.

* Fast Track Your Sales Career: You will have the opportunity to learn directly from experienced sales leaders. We provide the resources and opportunity; your proactive approach will pave the way for advancement into roles like Account Executive, Sales Manager, or Customer Success based on your interest.
* High Earning Potential: Your hard work is directly rewarded with a competitive compensation plan and high earning potential.
* Structured 2\-Month Enablement Program:


	+ Comprehensive new hire orientation.
	+ In\-depth training on the trades industry, customer personas, and our Ideal Client Profiles (ICP).
	+ Master our Tech Stack: Dedicated training on Salesforce, Salesloft, Gong, and ChiliPiper.
* Personalized Development: Benefit from one\-on\-one call review coaching sessions, interactive role\-playing, and hands\-on learning with your Manager.

**Hybrid Schedule:** Our policy states that if you are within \~40 miles of a Hub office, you will be required to go to the office 1\-2 days a week.

**A Note on the Application \& Hiring Process:** When you submit your application for the Marketing Development Representative (MDR) position, your candidacy will be considered for all available MDR opportunities across our entire organization, which includes ServiceTitan and its key subsidiaries: Aspire, FieldRoutes, and Convex.

jobs.title: Assistant Community Manager Ft
jobs.description:
The Habitat Company, LLC is a leader in residential multi\-family real estate management and development. We are looking for talented individuals to join our team as we continue to expand and develop our company nationwide. We are a multi\-state organization of approximately 500 team members specializing in the asset management, property management and project management of market rate, affordable rentals, condominiums and commercial real estate.


At The Habitat Company, we believe that it is the quality and experience of our team members that make a difference. Our professional team provides us with the depth of talent and ability that is so crucial to our success.


The Habitat Company provides comprehensive compensation to our team members. In addition to wages, this position is eligible for medical, dental, vision, 401k, and other benefits offered through Habitat, detailed here: https://www.habitat.com/our\-benefits

**Job Scope:**

The **Assistant Community Manager** is to assist the Community Manager in effectively managing the assigned community. In the Community Manager's absence, the Assistant Community Manager will assume all responsibilities associated with accomplishing community objectives as set forth by the Regional Manager and Property Ownership. In addition, the Assistant Community Manager is directly responsible for maintaining daily, weekly, and monthly reports including accurate reporting of rents and deposits received.


**Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Greet residents either by phone or in person, in a professional and courteous manner, and in line with Habitat’s Core Values.
* Report any physical concerns to manager when walking the property.
* Process Account Payables weekly.
* Attend all trainings/meetings as directed by the Regional Manager, Community Manager, or Compliance Manager for further advancement of your skill level and information.
* Assist with training and developing other team members as needed.
* Assist with requests from Regional Office, as necessary.
* Assist with the preparations for Audits.
* Assist with correspondence to/from IHDA/HUD as needed.
* Meet with IHDA/HUD representatives during various audits and respond to findings, as needed.
* Generate and close work orders, as needed.
* Transmit the monthly HAP Voucher by the 10th of every month.
* Monitor the recertification process to ensure team members are working efficiently to complete all recertifications in a timely fashion.
* Complete resident recertifications in accordance to HUD rules and regulations.
* Complete annual Gross Rent process in YARDI.
* When meeting with residents, document their file with any concerns complaints that could become a future issue for the Management Office.
* Prepare and submit property incident reports, as needed, on the Habitat Liability form and copying the Community Manager and Regional Manager.
* Assist with planning and participating in community activities.
* Conduct all business in accordance with The Habitat Company policies and procedures, Fair Housing, Americans with Disabilities Act, and all other laws pertaining to property management.
* Maintain awareness of local marketing conditions and trends; contribute ideas to the Community Manager for marketing property and improving resident satisfaction.
* Complete payroll when the Community Manager is not present.
* Inform the Community Manager of any issues that you are not able to resolve, using the appropriate form of communication.
* Keep a monthly log of major resident concerns and management issues and provide the information to the Community Manager for completion of the Executive Summary by the 17th of the following month.
* Perform other related duties as assigned

**Skills and Qualifications:**

* High school education or equivalent in work experience.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel).
* Ability to assist the property manager in day\-to\-day activities.
* Preferred accreditations include Certified Occupancy Specialist (COS) and EIV certification.
* Previous experience conducting recertifications preferred.
* IL Leasing License or ability to obtain within 120 days of hire

**ABOUT ROCKET LAB**



Rocket Lab is the end\-to\-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity's reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

**SOCIAL MEDIA \& DIGITAL COMMUNICATIONS SPECIALIST**

The Rocket Lab communications team translates literal rocket science into impactful and compelling stories that captivate the globe. We are looking for a Social Media \& Digital Communications Specialist who lives and breathes digital storytelling, thrives in high\-stakes environments, and wants to run one of the most exciting feeds in space. This is not a cruise\-control 9\-to\-5\. Rockets launch at 3:00 AM, mission milestones happen in real\-time across multiple time zones, and the unexpected is around every corner. If you want a comfortable corporate routine, this isn't it. If you want to shape the voice of a company shaping humanity's future in space, read on.


**WHAT YOU'LL GET TO DO:**

* **Build the Content Engine:** Plan, maintain, and execute an aggressive digital editorial calendar aligned with missions, program milestones, and strategic company goals.
* **Own the Channels**: Lead day\-to\-day execution across X, LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, Bluesky, subscriber newsletters and emerging platforms.
* **Understand the Audience:** Tailor content to our broad range of audiences spanning B2B and B2G, talent candidates, investors, and fans.
* **Cover the Action in Real Time:** Work with our media content producers to capture, package, and publish live coverage for launches, hot fires, spacecraft deployments, trade shows, and major company milestones.
* **Translate Rocket Science**: Partner directly with engineers, mission operators, and production teams to turn complex technical achievements into sharp, accessible content.
* **Drive Growth with Data:** Monitor platform analytics, spot trends before they fade, experiment with AI tools and new formats, and ruthlessly optimize for reach and engagement.
* **Guard the Brand Voice:** Ensure every caption, clip, graphic, and post matches Rocket Lab's standard of quality, technical accuracy, and unmistakable tone.
* **Expand the Frontier:** Challenge the status quo of how aerospace communicates. Bring fresh tech, unconventional distribution strategies, and bold creative experiments that keep us leagues ahead of the industry.
* **Roll Your Sleeves Up:** This isn't a pure strategy role insulated from the execution. You are on the tools every single day, drafting, shooting, editing, and driving projects from concept to feed. You can expect to live tweet countdowns, get out onto the factory floor to get the story, write the post, and hit publish yourself.


**YOU'LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS:**

* 5\+ years of experience. Proven track record running high\-growth, high\-engagement social channels and digital campaigns for a fast\-moving brand.
* A sharp portfolio with direct proof of killer campaigns you built and executed personally.
* Experience in both organic and paid social campaigns and strategies. Deep understanding of how to roll out effective paid social and digital campaigns to serve specific business needs.
* Flexibility to travel and move fast: Ready to support on\-site activations, events, and dynamic launch schedules across time zones.


 **THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE:**

* Bachelors degree.
* Ability to distil complex ideas into short, witty, punchy copy with zero fluff and flawless attention to detail.
* Extreme ownership. You don't wait for a brief. You spot what needs doing, hunt for an answer, pick up a camera, or open a draft, and get it done.
* Calm, decisive judgment when breaking news hits or launch countdowns are ticking live.
* Experience in aerospace, defence, motorsport or tech industries.
* An authentic obsession with space exploration and technology.
* You don't have to be able to have hands on photo/video capture and mobile editing skills but it would be beneficial.
* Experience in a start\-up environment


*This position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, computer work, and occasional exposure to moderate levels of noise, dust, and fumes in production areas.*

**WHAT TO EXPECT**



We're on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that's not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out\-think, out\-work, and out\-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other's backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way.

new_jobs.title: Technical Account Manager
new_jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, US
new_jobs.description:
Technical Account Manager

BAY AREA · NORTHERN CALIFORNIA FULL\-TIME BASE \+ MILESTONE BONUSES \+ UNCAPPED COMMISSION

01\. ABOUT US

Trilion Quality Systems is a precision metrology and NDE company based in King of Prussia, PA, and the US representative for ZEISS IQS optical testing systems. Our sister company, Xi Analytics, develops real\-time optical metrology and AI\-based measurement technology for advanced material testing and aerospace structural applications.

As the exclusive ZEISS Certified Metrology Partner in North America, Trilion’s experienced team of thirty people has spent the last 30 years doing one thing: connecting physical measurement with certified digital insight. More than 90% of the top ten US aerospace, automotive, biomechanics, and electronics companies work with us as their ZEISS DIC partner. This means that you will spend most weeks on innovative projects at Fortune 100 aerospace, defense, automotive, and consumer electronics companies, on test articles that are usually confidential, and you will be the person they call first. We’re an agile team and you won’t waste months waiting on committees and layers of management.

02\. ABOUT THE ROLE

Trilion is opening a Bay Area office around San Mateo in 2026 and hiring a Technical Account Manager to carry Northern California. This is a quota\-carrying, field\-based role, and you will be the primary technical and commercial contact for customers in the territory from the first conversation through demonstration, proposal, purchase order, and long\-term account growth.

You will spend most of your week in front of engineers in their test labs, not behind a desk. Optical metrology is sold by showing it, so much of the job is setting up a system on a customer's test article and letting the data make the argument. Strain gauges read a handful of points and miss the concentrations and asymmetries that decide whether a design passes certification. Full\-field DIC makes every pixel a measurement point, in 3D, NIST\-traceable, and ready for FEA correlation in minutes.

You will not be just a coordinator who forwards technical questions. Once ramped, you are expected to be able to run standard demonstrations and beginner trainings yourself, with our expert engineering team behind you for complex projects, dedicated multi\-day training, and on\-site service work. The technical credibility that comes with it is how you sell on results and direct knowledge rather than on a brochure.

You will not be working a blank list. Leads reach you through ZEISS and through Trilion’s own marketing, and you will generate the rest yourself at proven trade shows, through customer referrals, and by developing accounts we already serve. Revenue splits close to evenly three ways: new accounts, new teams inside existing accounts, and recurring business from our customer base. This means that a majority of projects will come from customers who already know and trust us, which is why account management matters here as much as new business. The ramp is deliberate: expect full autonomy over the territory within 6 to 8 months, backed by milestone bonuses while the funnel builds. Your first three months will follow a structured onboarding plan with active coaching, defined milestones and hands\-on time alongside our engineers, so you are not left to work it out on your own. Capital equipment cycles are long, but we don’t starve a good engineer waiting for the first sale to close.

03\. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Territory and accounts

* Own the Bay Area and Northern California territory across aerospace, microelectronics and consumer electronics, space and defense, automotive and EV, medical device, and industrial and civil structures
* Work inbound leads from ZEISS and our digital marketing through qualification to first meeting
* Generate the rest of your pipeline yourself: trade show and conference follow\-up, referrals, and prospecting into new groups inside accounts we already serve
* Support existing accounts and identify follow\-on system, software, and service opportunities
* Forecast territory opportunities accurately and keep management updated on a regular cadence

Technical selling and delivery

* Present and demonstrate ARAMIS, ATOS, TRITOP, and the wider ZEISS portfolio at customer test labs and trade shows
* Run standard demonstrations and basic software training independently once ramped, including specimen preparation and system setup
* Process and present measurement results, and run proof\-of\-concept engagements and ROI analyses tied to the customer's test program
* Bring in our engineering team for complex projects, multi\-day training, and service work

Deal execution

* Design and develop tailored proposals and system configurations
* Manage the full sales process from first contact through purchase order
* Maintain accurate account, contact, and opportunity records in HubSpot CRM and Odoo ERP

04\. ABOUT YOU

* 2 to 3 years of experience in technical sales, applications engineering, or hands\-on test and measurement work, in aerospace \& defense, electronics \& AR/VR hardware, automotive \& EV, robotics, biomechanics, material science or an adjacent field
* MS/BS in Mechanical/Aerospace Engineering, Material Science or similar Engineering Major
* Comfortable with mechanical engineering fundamentals: strain, stress, fatigue, and structural test
* Comfortable explaining technical concepts clearly and concisely to test engineers and executives
* Hands\-on experience with test equipment or measurement instrumentation, and the confidence to run a live system demonstration in front of a customer without support
* Willing and able to generate your own pipeline: outbound calls and emails, trade show and conference follow\-up, and prospecting into adjacent groups at existing accounts
* Organized and self\-directed; this territory runs on a plan you build yourself
* Excellent computer skills including AI usage for day\-to\-day sales engineerin

**Overview**



Avanath is proud to be named one of the top property management companies that provide affordable housing for the workforce.


*Cultivating the American Dream* is the purpose that binds the Avanath team. At Avanath, every day is an opportunity to make a difference in someone's life. Whether it is helping residents call one of our communities home, providing excellence in customer service, or championing our workforce, we are committed to creating an unforgettable experience as a great place to live, work, and be.


**The Role:**This role is responsible for assisting in all operational duties of the Community Manager, including reporting, rent processing, leasing, marketing, and overseeing the community and associates in the Community Manager's absence.


***The incumbent in this role must possess a high degree of professionalism and positive engagement for our residents and the workforce.***


* **An Aptitude for Connecting \-** Must possessa strong sense for creating a sense of community, as well as the drive to go the extra mile to create a positive experience for all residents and staff. Your success and purpose are driven by the relationships that you build within your communities, including vendor partners, regulatory, and social services partnerships. This includes adopting a collaborative approach to create consistent, favorable circumstances that foster success and effectiveness for the Organization and the communities.
* **An Authentic Attitude \-** Consistently demonstrate an open and professional attitude and approach when accessing and resolving resident and staff concerns. This includes, but is not limited to, seeking resources throughout the organization via the organization's support services and senior leadership.
* **An Approach that is positive and Professional** \- Consistently demonstrate an approach of active listening and understand that your participation and support are integral to the success of Avanath, ensuring that each resident and staff member feels seen, heard, and valued as you and the staff work to resolve challenges.


**Qualifications**


* 2\+ years' experience as an Assistant Community Manager.
* LIHTC/Tax Credit Program Knowledge required.
* Equipped with excellent communication skills and an unmatched dedication to customer service.
* Solid track record of bookkeeping and rent collection.
* Thorough understanding of landlord/tenant law.
* Strong Understanding of Fair Housing Laws.
* Superior interpersonal skills: ability to get along with diverse personalities; tactful; mature, flexible.
* Resourceful and organized.
* Solid computer knowledge, Windows (Word, Excel), internet, and e\-mail.
* Working knowledge of Yardi Voyager Property Management software.


**Key Accountabilities**

\+ **Resident Relations \+ Customer Service**


* At all times, regardless, provides A\+ customer service.
* Manages and promotes resident satisfaction and retention by responding to complaints, questions, and requests in a timely manner, and taking appropriate action to resolve and address service issues.
* Functions as a resource center for residents on all things that affect and may disturb their community\-living experience and ability to make timely rent payments.
* Organizes and executes resident appreciation and retention events.
* Maintains a secure, confidential file for each resident.
* Answering phones, greeting walk\-ins, and handling foot traffic.
* Assist with leasing job duties, including touring prospective residents.


\+ **Fiduciary**


* Handles all the monies of the property. Collects, posts, and deposits rents/security deposits and other community income.
* Reviews resident files and ledger records to determine unpaid and/or late fees owed, communicates with residents regarding outstanding balances, implements procedures for collecting on delinquencies, and enforces the lease agreements.
* Assist with Monthly Projection Reporting, inspect vacancies, make\-ready apartments, and models. Inspects the property for community policy violations, needed repairs, and overall landscaping.
* Meets regularly with Community Manager and Regional Manager to discuss community performance.
* Other duties as assigned by Community Manager.


\+ **Staff Leadership**


* Maintains a service\-oriented environment by always exhibiting a professional appearance and attitude.
* Oversees property operations and staff in Community Manager's absence.
* Support Leasing Consultants in the leasing of apartments and ensure that Fair Housing guidelines are followed.
* Under the direction of the Compliance department and the Community Manager, manages compliance file maintenance, where applicable.


\+ **Adherence to Property Management Rules, Regulations, and Guidelines**


* Conduct all business in accordance with company policies and procedures, Fair Housing, *Americans with Disabilities Act,* and all other laws pertaining to the apartment industry.
* Under the direction of the Compliance department and the Community Manager, manages compliance file maintenance, where applicable.
* Follows the Company's established procedures related to evictions by following proper notice requirements, evicting residents, and representing the property as required in court hearings and eviction proceedings.


**Physical Demands \& Working Conditions**

* The incumbent in this position is classified as essential staff and is expected to report to work and adhere to all safety and business protocols.
* Frequent sitting and walking.
* Repetitive use of the computer, keyboard, mouse, and phone.
* Reading, comprehending, writing, performing calculations, and communicating verbally.
* May work in an elevated site, may walk on uneven ground.
* Occasional squatting, bending neck/waist, twisting neck/waist, pushing, and pulling.


**How Avanath Supports You**



We know that our teams are the heart of our success and growth, and we are committed to showing our appreciation.

new_jobs.title: Research Coordinator – Women’s Brain Health Research
new_jobs.description:
In this role, the successful candidate will independently coordinate and manage the day\-to\-day conduct of an NIH\-funded research study on **women’s brain health** (RF1AG098531\) conducted at the NYU Grossman School of Medicine. The Research Coordinator exercises independent judgment and discretion in managing study operations, resolving protocol and regulatory issues, determining participant eligibility, and analyzing study data — serving as the primary point of accountability for the study’s day\-to\-day scientific and operational integrity, under the general direction of the Principal Investigators.

  

  

  

### **Project**

  

  

This NIH\-funded project, led by Drs. Erika Raven and Jelle Veraart, focuses on improving women’s brain health by identifying why the menopause transition may increase the risk of cognitive decline and Alzheimer’s disease. Using longitudinal neuroimaging, plasma proteomics, and detailed clinical assessments of a prospective cohort, the study examines how hormonal changes and menopausal hormone therapy influence brain aging and cognitive outcomes. The goal is to define sex\-specific biomarkers and risk profiles that support earlier detection, more precise prevention, and clinically meaningful strategies to protect women’s health across midlife and aging.


### **Job Responsibilities**


**Study Coordination \& Regulatory Compliance**
* Independently manage the day\-to\-day operations of the study, exercising judgment to resolve protocol deviations, scheduling conflicts, and other non\-routine issues as they arise, escalating to the PIs only when appropriate
* Interpret and apply IRB and sponsor requirements; prepare, submit, and track continuing reviews, amendments, and reportable events, determining the appropriate course of action for ambiguous or non\-routine regulatory situations

**Participant Recruitment, Screening \& Eligibility Determination**
* Independently review medical records and screening data against complex study eligibility criteria; exercise judgment on borderline or ambiguous cases and make enrollment recommendations to the Principal Investigators
* Lead the informed consent process, ensuring participants understand study procedures, risks, and rights; manage enrollment, scheduling, and long\-term follow\-up of a prospective cohort

**Data Collection \& Quality Oversight**
* Coordinate and, where applicable, assist with MRI data collection, cognitive testing, and survey administration; select and adapt procedures to participant\-specific circumstances (e.g., menopause status, scheduling constraints) within study guidelines
* Oversee blood sample collection, storage, and shipping logistics for the plasma proteomics component of the study, ensuring compliance with protocol and chain\-of\-custody requirements

**Data Analysis, Reporting \& Team Liaison**
* Consolidate and analyze longitudinal clinical, imaging, and biomarker data; identify trends and data quality issues, and prepare summaries and recommendations that inform manuscript development and study reporting
* Serve as the primary liaison between the PIs, study team members, core facilities, and external collaborators, exercising discretion in coordinating cross\-functional study activities
### **Required Qualifications**


Bachelor’s degree in life sciences or a related discipline is required, along with a minimum of 2 years of clinical or human subjects research experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. Must demonstrate the ability to exercise independent judgment and discretion in coordinating study operations, resolving non\-routine issues, and interfacing with participants, investigators, and regulatory bodies with minimal supervision. Effective oral and written communication and interpersonal skills, along with strong time management, organizational, and analytical skills, are required.
### **Preferred Qualifications**


Knowledge of basic medical terminology is preferred. Prior experience independently coordinating research protocols, and working with EPIC and REDCap, is preferred. Experience working in an academic medical center environment, and prior experience training or guiding junior research staff, is also preferred.


### **About Us**


NYU Grossman School of Medicine provides its staff with far more than just a place to work. Rather, we are an institution you can be proud of, an institution where you’ll feel good about devoting your time and your talents. At NYU Langone Health, we are committed to supporting our workforce and their loved ones with a comprehensive benefits and wellness package. Our offerings provide a robust support system for any stage of life, whether it’s developing your career, starting a family, or saving for retirement. The support employees receive goes beyond a standard benefit offering, where employees have access to financial security benefits, a generous time\-off program and employee resources groups for peer support. Additionally, all employees have access to our holistic employee wellness program, which focuses on seven key areas of well\-being: physical, mental, nutritional, sleep, social, financial, and preventive care. The benefits and wellness package is designed to allow you to focus on what truly matters. Join us and experience the extensive resources and services designed to enhance your overall quality of life for you and your family.


NYU Grossman School of Medicine is an equal opportunity employer and committed to inclusion in all aspects of recruiting and employment. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply and will receive consideration. We require applications to be completed online.

new_jobs.description:
The DERMS Operations Specialist plays a crucial role in the development and implementation of the Distributed Energy Resource Management System (DERMS). This newly created position offers a unique opportunity to be at the forefront of innovation, laying the groundwork for the expansion of energy management within the distribution system. The DERMS Operations Specialist is responsible for the real\-time and near\-real\-time operational integration of Distributed Energy Resources (DERs) on the electric distribution system. This role ensures DERs are operated safely, reliably, and in compliance with grid constraints, using DERMS and related advanced distribution applications. The specialist serves as a technical bridge between distribution system operators, planning, IT/OT systems, and DER programs.


Currently, DERMS is in Phase I of implementation, focusing on visibility of the distribution system. During this stage, the DERMS Operations Specialist will maintain system awareness, monitor distributed resources, and evaluate load and generation forecasts. As the program prepares for Phase II, which includes system optimization and dispatch, the DERMS Operations Specialist will contribute to the development of user interfaces, tools, and processes necessary for seamless and reliable DERMS operations. As new distributed resources are integrated, the specialist will ensure communication paths are established for real\-time monitoring and dispatch.


This role will initially follow a hybrid work schedule, with four days per week, Monday through Thursday, at the office located at 241 Ralph McGill.

* Partner with internal teams and external vendors to improve website performance, SEO, SEM, paid media, and digital customer experience initiatives.

new_jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
new_jobs.description:
**Company Overview:**


**About Us:**  

Atlanta\-based Incident IQ is the leading workflow management platform built exclusively for K\-12 districts. Trusted by over 2,000 districts, Incident IQ powers mission\-critical services for more than 12 million students and educators nationwide. By connecting technology and operational workflows, Incident IQ enables schools to streamline processes, reduce administrative burdens, and focus on what matters most: supporting students.


**Purpose:**  

Incident IQ is committed to creating a future where every K\-12 district operates with seamless efficiency. When operations are unified on a single platform, districts gain the clarity and control needed to build a stronger foundation for student success. We're focused on delivering the tools, support, and partnerships that help make that vision a reality.


**Mission:**  

Incident IQ is on a mission to eliminate the friction of disconnected systems and clunky workflows that slow schools down. We're reimagining the critical work that happens behind the scenes, bringing visibility, efficiency, and impact to the processes that keep classrooms running. By streamlining the complex, automating the routine, and surfacing the insights that matter most, we can create the conditions for educators to teach, students to thrive, and districts to shape the future of education.

**Sales Development Representative Overview:**

  



Reporting directly to the Revenue Operations Leader, the Sales Development Representative SDR) will be responsible for generating interest and qualifying leads with target school districts within assigned territories.

  



The SDR will work actively with our field sales team to identify target school districts and implement outreach cadences to generate and qualify leads for our products. The GDR will also work extensively within our marketing automation and AI\-powered tools to identify, develop, and qualify leads for our field sales team. This role also manages and maintains our lead process protocols to ensure all qualified sales leads are properly distributed and tracked in our sales support systems.

  



Our Sales Development Team thrives on culture and collaboration, so working together 2\-3 days a week in one of our two offices \- Alpharetta and Atlanta \- is required.

  


**Sales Development Representative Responsibilities:**


* Generate new business pipeline primarily through outbound prospecting
* Operate within RevOps at the intersection of Sales and Marketing, working inside a centrally coordinated outreach cadence that sequences prospect touches across Demand Gen, SDR, and Sales to prevent duplicate or conflicting outreach
* Design effective outbound prospecting sequences to effectively contact target school districts
* Engage and qualify prospects using agentic\-powered workflows, insights, and automated intelligence
* Utilize AI agents to research accounts, tailor messaging, and execute high\-quality outreach at scale, alongside core sales tech stack
* Activate demand by delivering personalized engagement across email, phone, social, and in\-product channels
* Partner with Demand Generation to act on campaign and account signals in real time, prioritizing outreach based on the most current marketing and sales intelligence available
* Carry and consistently deliver against a quota and activity metrics, tracked through Salesforce/Gong, and reported in a weekly goal\-setting and readout cadence
* Represent Incident IQ at industry conferences, trade shows, and marketing\-hosted events, including independently engaging prospects and conducting account drop\-ins as needed
* Work strategically with your field sales partner on a Go\-to\-Market strategy

  


**Sales Development Representative Requirements:**


* Four (4\) year college degree, or equivalent
* Experience or interest in working with AI\-powered sales engagement tools to improve prospecting efficiency and outreach quality
* Sales tech experience \- Primarily Salesforce, Gong, and Qualified to maximize performance and efficiency
* High energy, high activity personality and personal drive

 **What makes Incident IQ different:**


* We facilitate whole\-person growth where employees can develop personally as well as professionally.
* We offer an energetic and collaborative environment; everyone's opinion matters!
* We produce software that empowers K\-12 schools to run efficiently, allowing for a better classroom experience for students to THRIVE!
* We provide excellent work/life balance. Two amazing offices \- a Downtown Atlanta office location and one at Halcyon in Alpharetta!

  



Incident IQ offers a competitive salary based on experience with a benefits package for full\-time employees that includes medical, dental, vision, life insurance, 401k match, and paid\-time off (PTO).

  




*Incident IQ is an Equal Opportunity Employer*

Thank you for your interest in Mueller Water Products, Inc.


For more than 165 years, Mueller Water Products, Inc. has been building the future of water infrastructure. From lifesaving fire protection to data intelligence, we are committed to developing products and solutions that help cities and utilities deliver clean, safe drinking water to hundreds of millions of people across North America.


Our purpose is to connect communities to water, life’s most essential resource, with exceptional, people solutions and products. Behind that purpose is a dedicated team, united by our shared values of respect, integrity, trust, inclusion and safety. With a vision to be the leader in water infrastructure solutions—solving challenges, enriching lives and safeguarding the future—we are making a positive impact that will last for generations.


By joining Mueller, you become part of a dynamic team dedicated to excellence and innovation, working collaboratively to achieve meaningful results. We champion our people because when they succeed, our communities thrive. We invite you to learn more about career opportunities with us and consider submitting your application.


Executive Assistant**Essential Duties:**

* Support and assists 3 executive level staff members, in a fast\-paced environment, by providing a broad range of administrative support, as well as working with and providing back\-up support to other administrative resources across the Company
* Maintain and regularly update HR organizational charts, leadership team structures, and talent planning materials, ensuring accuracy and timely distribution for executive and board\-level reviews. Updates and guidance to be provided by CHRO and HR leadership team.
* Prepare, consolidate, and distribute recurring HR reports, dashboards, presentations, and workforce\-related metrics for the CHRO, HR Leadership Team, and senior executives. These reports are already designed by HR leadership and generally this requires report consolidation and pulling reports from existing data sets.
* Coordinate and manage HR Leadership Team meetings, HR staff meetings, and strategic planning sessions, including agenda development, meeting logistics, materials preparation, action item tracking, and follow\-up.
* Owns calendar management by planning and scheduling meetings, conferences, teleconferences, travel, and reservations for various activities and events, including catering
* Prepare, review and submit expense reports, following Company policies and procedures
* Develops and maintains good relationships with members of the executive team and other internal staff, seeks to understand and anticipate needs to maximize efficiency of the leaders
* Prepares, organizes and maintains information electronically and hard copy as needed, examples include documents and contracts, vendor information and payments, and internal and external correspondence
* Prepares professional\-quality presentations and reports for internal and external audiences, including the company’s executive leadership team
* Prepares outgoing correspondence such as mail, e\-mail, memos, letters and faxes
* Implements and maintains filing systems; electronic and hard copy if needed
* Manages special projects as needed and other duties as assigned

**Skills, Knowledge, Experience Abilities:**

* Minimum of 5 years of administrative support experience, preferably with 2\-3 years providing administrative support to senior level and/or C\-suite executives
* Experience providing administrative support in a publicly traded company preferred
* BA/BS, or equivalent education, highly desired
* Must possess high level of computer literacy, including strong Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, One Drive/SharePoint, Teams, etc.) skills
* Experience with web\-based systems such as Concur, or related T\&E system, for business travel \& expense is strongly desired
* Experience with expense report management for self and others. Must be comfortable with numerical/analytical work
* Experience with project management and accounting tools preferred (Asasa, Tungsten, JDE, etc.)

**Traits and Competencies:**

* Proactively and readily assumes responsibility to carry out assignments in a proficient and professional manner and ensures follow\-through and follow\-up
* Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously and independently, as well as working collaboratively with others
* Must possess excellent communication skills, both oral and written, and have excellent telephone, video conference and interpersonal skills
* Ability to maintain confidential and highly sensitive information and exercise discretion in dealing with others
* Must be detail oriented, organized, have excellent time\-management skills and be customer service focused
* Exhibits strong work ethic, takes initiative and can ‘read the room’ and adjust to the needs of the customer
* Eager to learn new skills, chip in and assist where needed, while recognizing and balancing priorities


**Other Compensation \& Benefits:**


Mueller offers an excellent salary and benefits package. Current benefit offerings include medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401k plan with 5% Company match, Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), short\-term and long\-term disability benefits, vacation, 100% paid parental leave, tuition reimbursement program, student debt retirement matching, well\-being program, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), company\-provided life insurance, supplemental insurance at group rates, and more.

Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. **Job Summary and Responsibilities**  

As our TLC Performance Enablement Coordinator, you will play a critical role in supporting the delivery of our enterprise performance enablement strategy by managing the operational cadence of annual and ongoing performance processes. To be successful in this role, you will leverage your strong organizational skills and collaborative mindset to drive continuous improvement across our performance enablement framework. You will utilize data\-driven reporting and stakeholder feedback to identify opportunities for enhancement, ensuring our practices remain compliant, efficient, and aligned with organizational goals. Your ability to navigate complex, matrixed environments—ideally within a large healthcare setting—will be essential as you provide guidance, training, and support to stakeholders to drive consistent adoption of performance excellence.* Coordinate annual performance cycles, goal management processes, and ongoing performance discussions across the enterprise.
* Manage operational documentation, project plans, and communication materials to ensure program delivery excellence.
* Provide high\-level administrative support for performance systems, including system testing, vendor coordination, and issue resolution.
* Develop and maintain user resources, including job aids, templates, and knowledge articles to support leaders and HR partners.
* Monitor program metrics and generate dashboards to track effectiveness and identify opportunities for process improvement.
* Support leader enablement by coordinating training sessions and fostering consistent adoption of performance management best practices.

**Job Requirements****Required*** Education \- Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Organizational Development, Healthcare Administration, or a related field required.
* One to Three (1\-3\) years of experience in: coordinating enterprise programs, projects, or operational processes; supporting HR systems, enterprise technology platforms, or business process administration; developing communications, training materials, reports, or documentation.
* Must have strong organizational and project coordination skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.

**Preferred*** Change management
* Continuous improvement


Where You'll Work  

Inspired by faith. Driven by innovation. Powered by humankindness. CommonSpirit Health is building a healthier future for all through its integrated health services. As one of the nation’s largest nonprofit Catholic healthcare organizations, CommonSpirit Health delivers more than 20 million patient encounters annually through more than 2,300 clinics, care sites and 137 hospital\-based locations, in addition to its home\-based services and virtual care offerings. new_jobs.description:
### **Who We Are**



At ERC Pathlight, we're on a mission to change lives—and we're looking for people who feel called to do the same.



As one of the nation's leading treatment providers for eating disorders and mood, anxiety, and trauma\-related conditions, we bring innovative, evidence\-based, and deeply compassionate care to patients across the country. With multiple locations nationwide and extensive virtual programming, we meet patients exactly where they are and help them move toward lasting recovery.



Founded in 2008 by renowned psychiatrists and psychologists, ERC Pathlight now supports more than 6,000 patients each year. And as the need for world\-class mental health care continues to rise, our commitment is stronger than ever: to expand access, elevate the standard of care, and empower every patient to rebuild their life with dignity and hope.


### **Why Join Us**



When you join ERC Pathlight, you become part of a team that shows up every day to make a real difference. You'll work alongside passionate clinicians, dedicated support staff, and mission\-driven leaders who believe in collaboration, growth, and doing the right thing—always.



Here, your work matters. Your ideas matter. **You** matter.



If you're energized by purpose, motivated by impact, and ready to help transform the future of mental health treatment, you belong here.


**Come build hope. Come save lives. Come grow with us.**


**What you'll be doing:**



Schedule: (PT MID 9:30am\-10:00pm)



The Program Coordinator (PC I, PC II, PC III) is responsible for the direct care of inpatient, residential, and partial hospitalization patients by providing patient supervision and support. The PCs provide structure and boundaries for our patients. They provide bathroom and milieu support as well as contribute to the implementation of therapeutic programming which may include care delivery and program documentation. The PCs provide mealtime support, supporting patients with their dietary needs, and supervising patients at meals and snacks.



The PC should be able to:


* Be willing and able to work at all ERC Pathlight local sites as assigned
* Be compliant with certification and regulatory requirements for each practice location
* Maintain a flexible schedule to meet organizational staffing needs
* Be available to work weekends and holidays as required
* Be available to work on\-call shifts based on business needs, in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local labor laws


**Essential duties and responsibilities:**


* Milieu Management, including (but not limited to) the following:
* Maintains daily program structure by following program schedule
* Completes observation rounds and safety checks as ordered by physician
* Works with patients on de\-escalation and implementing coping skills per treatment plan
* Conducts room searches and luggage searches
* Takes patients out on fresh air breaks and mindful movement exposures
* Provides ongoing bathroom monitoring
* Take patient vital signs, weights, urine Specific Gravity (may vary by location and program)
* Group Facilitation
* Participates in group facilitation
* Compliant with documentation in EHR for group facilitation
* Supports group outings
* Meal Support, including (but not limited to) the following:
* Participates in all meals and snacks with patients as needed per facility
* Provides meal support through coaching and skills per treatment team at eating disorder treatment locations (when not assigned to an eating disorder treatment location, performs other duties as assigned based on program and operational needs)
* Provides administrative support as needed around mealtimes
* Ensures adherence to allergy\-safety system
* Administrative Support
* Complete all appropriate documentation as needed in compliance with standards (some indicated above) including but not limited to patient observations, meals, and events that occur during shift
* Provides patient transportation as needed for medical appointments (may vary by location and program)
* Supports additional transportation needs, including but not limited to outings, grocery shopping, or other facility needs
* May provide support for additional food procurement as needed once per week
* Distributes mail and packages daily


**Must haves:**



Program Coordinator I (PC I)


* High School Diploma or GED (required)
* Valid driver's license with safe driving record: required only at locations operating company vehicles or requiring driving on behalf of the company (required)
* Washington teammates must hold a state credential (may be pending at time of hire) (required)
